notes.title: NosVersary: The Anniversary Event Server’s Coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64df2f5db3966060bcd8b2698fad3609d557b0c0.jpg

We’re celebrating NosTale’s 18th anniversary with a brand-new event server! Look forward to faster progress, epic boosts and exclusive achievements. Get ready to progress at breakneck speed like never before on a NosTale server!

NosVersary Server Starts: 24th September 2025
NosVersary Server Ends: 5th November 2025

What to expect on the NosVersary server:

Start out as a specialist straight at level 56, benefit from triple EXP and more.
Take part in boost events and weekend specials and make the most out of the event server!
Complete missions and snag some great rewards such as a server selection ticket and other handy items in the new anniversary Battle Pass!
Unlock cool rewards such as titles and pets via exclusive event achievements!
Free character transfer when the event server ends – migrate your new character to a regular server with the free character transfer in the Battle Pass and keep rocking your adventures there!
... and much more!

Top Anniversary Events on All Servers

In addition to our exclusive anniversary server, we also have a ton of anniversary action lined up for you on all other servers! There’s an anniversary calendar with gifts, the letter collecting event, a fan art contest with top prizes and much more to look forward to!

NosVersary FAQ

Find out everything you need to know about the NosVersary event server here!

How long will NosVersary be online before I can transfer registered characters?

NosVersary will be online for 6 weeks, from 24th September until 5th November 2025.

What’s special about NosVersary?

Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 21+5.
Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosVersary event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.

How do I transfer my character?

Characters are not transferred automatically.
Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards.
Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.

How do I choose a server?

There will be two different items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server.
The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosVersary event server closes to choose your destination server.

Where do I see which server I’ve selected?

You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).

Can I transfer my items with my character?

Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window), plus the regular and equipment inventories, will automatically transfer with them. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character.
Items from the warehouse, unlocked NosMall items, and active offers in the NosBazaar will be sent to you by parcel.

Will there be a Battle Pass?

Yes, there will be a free Battle Pass for the NosVersary server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: Caligor’s Spirit, upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, and transfer items.

Are there any rules for transferring?

Similar transfer rules will apply as for last year’s Summer Oasis. Details will be published in a separate FAQ news post.

Which boosts will be available and when?

The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosVersary server:
2x EXP (3x on some weekends)
2x Drops (3x on some weekends)
2x Gold
3x Fairy XP
2x EXP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
2x Family XP
4x Reputation
In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.

Will there also be events on the regular servers?

Yes, the regular servers will have similar events to NosVersary, though they will differ from the NosVersary events.

Can I change the name of my character on the NosVersary event server?

Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between 12/09 (11 AM) and 15/09 (11 AM CEST), you have a 50% improved chance to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

How Fairy Upgrades Work
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

How Fairy Enchantments Work
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting levels S, A and B!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Celestial Spire Catacombs: The Family Challenge Awaits
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6bec5b0535f7ae072f2c6a1860f2c1f6a0d76e9d.jpg

It’s time for a new chapter in your destiny, as the Celestial Spire Catacombs call out to you… and this time, you will not be alone. Rally your family around you and venture into the depths together in the latest challenging group mode in NosTale from 10th September 2025 (11 AM CEST).

Master a tactical tower defence experience, with new maps, dangerous monsters and increasing difficulty. Join forces to protect the totem from the forces of darkness – and remember that a single mistake could spell your doom!

New: Family Mode in the Celestial Spire Catacombs

Descend the Celestial Spire Catacombs with your family. Access to the new zone is granted via the Celestial Spire Catacombs Manager NPC in Act 9, located in Undercity. Here’s where your journey through the 20 levels of the Celestial Spire Catacombs begins.

Access & Requirements

Only champion level 80+ characters can participate
Weekly limit: 50 entries
Every family member can open levels
Groups consist of 8 to 12 players, and multiple teams can enter simultaneously
Only previously unlocked levels are accessible
Levels 1 through 20 are unlocked in turn via family progress
Monthly reset: Every month you must start your descent afresh; your progress will be reset, and the challenge starts from the beginning

Mechanics: Defend the Totem

The totem is at the heart of the action; if this is destroyed, your attempt fails.
Monsters will appear in increasingly difficult waves, attacking from random directions, with more monsters appearing the more companions you have.
Special effects and other dangers such as meteor showers and other mechanics make each level unique.
Should a player die, they can respawn on the same level using a Celestial Spire Catacombs First-Aid Kit. If they choose not to do this, or the whole team dies, then the entry is spent.

Rewards & Progress
Each successfully completed level affords:

Catacomb Tokens redeemable in the new token shop for:
New pets
Handy consumables
... and more!

Missions & Quests

notes.title: Celestial Spire Catacombs – Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg

It’s been a while, but we’re now back with the family edition of the Celestial Spire – the Celestial Spire Catacombs!

Prepare for this thrilling adventure and battle your way through all the levels with your family.

The Celestial Spire Catacombs:
General rules:
Champion level 80+8–12 playersInitial weekly limit of 50 entriesEntry via a new NPC in UndercityProgress resets monthlyNew skill for entering the Celestial Spire Catacombs, similar to the Raid List (the leader must start the expedition with the NPC)
Combat system rules:
Monsters get stronger each levelSix lives with 1 totem to defend; if all your lives are used up, or the totem is destroyed, you fail to complete the levelThe more team members present, the more monsters will appearThere are currently no squads in the Celestial Spire CatacombsIt is possible to resurrect in a level using a special item
Rewards and missions: (https://nostale.comastuff.com/Celestial_Spire_Catacombs.pdf, only in english)
Level rewards: Random rewards for completing a levelOne-time monthly rewards for first completing a levelGuaranteed rewards for completing a levelMonthly family rewards: Passive buffs which reset on the 1st of every monthPassive buffs to increase damage and defence, skills for double drops, and moreUnique family quests: Quests awarding FXPPermanent passive buffs for reducing family expansion costs and moreDaily family quests: Daily quests awarding FXPMonthly rankings: Families compete according to levels and time, and receive rewards based for their rank at the beginning of the monthUnique weekly missions (found in the Progress Book): Quests which provide materials and Celestial Spire Catacombs TokensCelestial Spire Catacombs Token Shop: You can exchange Celestial Spire Catacombs Tokens for various items such as:Resistances, passive skill books, new pets and more
General changes:
Added a Celestial Spire Catacombs Team Stone to the Alchemist in UndercityIt is no longer possible to heal the totem in the regular Celestial SpireAdded an overview of raid team members, visible when clicking on a team in the Raid List
Clarifications:

 The entry count for the Celestial Spire Catacombs is reduced the moment the stage lever is pulled, not when you or your team fails.
 Celestial Spire Catacombs Level progress is individual, through the help of your family, not based on your family's highest progress.
 If you die, you will lay on the ground for another 60 seconds. If your team clears the level during this time, the run will also count as successful for you. If the team clears the level after 60 or more seconds since your death, it will count as a fail for you.
 The effect "HP is increased by x% of damage given" is deactivated inside the Celestial spire catacombs
 There is no MP consumption in the Celestial spire catacombs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/06324a77fb22d3091e6708b341086002f67f3397.jpg

And our summer action continues with two familiar events! Look out for the fearsome pirate Captain Pete O’Peng and the slippery Lola Lopears and her band of bunnies! Confront them and win great rewards!

Event period: 21st August (11 AM) to 17th September (11 AM CEST).

More Dangerous Than Ever: Captain Pete O’Peng!
Yo-ho-ho, Captain Pete O’Peng is back! After voyaging the seven seas, he’s returned… and he’s badder than ever before! He’ll be causing mischief again this summer and he reckons you won’t stand a chance against him this time. What do you say to that? Show that rascally freebooter what you’re made of!
Eliminate the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona, the ‘Arrrrr!’ title or one of the four Pirate Bushtails amongst many other items.Slip on the elegant Navy Costume! The Captain’s Hat provides a 2% chance of inflicting Strong Freeze on your opponent. The costume provides a 5% chance of reducing all attack damage by 80%. Both items of clothing increase your water resistance by 2%.The Arrrrr! title increases your HP by +300 and will show Captain Pete O’Peng who the real pirate is around here!
Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing!
Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid for 5 to 8 players – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

What Else?
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the Lopears title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Great NosTombola Returns – Every Ticket’s a Winner!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0eac7c031a052084f7709b5d1d1779cfdcc17394.jpg

Dip your hand in the hat and seize this opportunity to grab some fantastic prizes between 30th July (11 AM) and 3rd September (23:59 CEST)!

How the NosTombola Works
Every player may take part in the NosTombola. It can be found in the NosMall in the game. There you can use tickets to win amazing prizes! Each ticket grants either one of the valuable daily jackpot prizes, a lucky token or an item as a direct prize.
You can purchase 10 tickets for NosJewels every day.Up to 6 tickets can also be purchased at a slightly cheaper price for the following day.Each new day of the NosTombola begins at 4 AM CEST.
Precious NosJewels
For each purchase in the NosMall, you will be credited a certain number of NosJewels. The number of NosJewels you receive can be seen in the details in the NosMall.

You can use the NosJewels to purchase tickets, or to buy items directly in the Jewel Shop. The more tickets you use, the greater your chances to get the current day’s jackpot.

Free Daily Ticket
Don’t miss your free ticket! You can get one of these every day per account if you have completed the main quest line of Act 4 (before the start of the tombola), or if you have purchased at least one ticket for three days in a row.

The Lucky Tokens
Some of the tickets have lucky tokens behind them for you to collect. Every three tokens can be exchanged for a prize. Once you collect three lucky tokens, you will receive the corresponding prize according to the total points. You can only use more tickets once this prize has been redeemed. Alternatively you can re-roll your three tokens, however this costs 20 NosDollars.

You can receive these and many other items with the lucky tokens:
Divine Shell UpgradeChristmas Tree WingsChampion Amulet for Increasing RarityShadow Element Steam Drone

notes.title: Event: Lord Melonoth’s Summer Raid
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d9ae25b0d1d7bb8825553fd9f1e7141f015c7383.jpg

Get ready for a fruitastic challenge this summer! Battle against fruity monsters like Bananosaurus and Dragon Fruitlets, then defeat Lord Melonoth himself in the brand-new summer raid!

Rewards such as little fruit pets, an additional mini pet, the Fruity Ninja title and much more await!

Running: 23rd July (11 AM) to 20th August (11 AM CEST)

The Story So Far

Some time ago, the Mullans of Undercity started to trade with people from the surface. These new dealings gave the Mullans their first taste of fresh fruit! One tribe member, by the name of Doctor Frox, was munching down on some of this fruit from the surface, and became absolutely obsessed with the taste.

He focused all of his energies on cultivating varieties of fruit plants which would be capable of surviving in the darkness of Undercity. He set up Frox’s Fruit Lab as a research institute and started a number of botanical experiments. Using a specially developed serum, Doctor Frox wanted to promote growth in his plants.
The first results were fruitful, and his plants flourished despite the total darkness. But something went wrong... the serum had some unexpected side effects. The plants mutated, outgrowing their natural size and becoming intelligent – and hostile!
The fruit monsters broke out of the laboratory and made their way to the surface, where they started to attack the surrounding settlements.

Riddled with guilt, Doctor Frox has followed them to the surface, and is now searching for help. He needs someone who is courageous and strong enough to stop these unbridled creatures, before they can plunge the surface into chaos.

Raid Info

In order to participate in the Lord Melonoth Raid, you must first complete the Time-Space quest Lab on Alert. Only the raid leader needs Lord Melonoth’s Raid Seal to start the raid.

You also receive the Fresh Melon Rind (Event) in reward which allows you to deal double damage to the mini-bosses and the raid boss.

The Time-Space quest can be completed up to 5 times per day. The raid can be entered via Fruit Fiend Portal in NosVille.

A maximum of 15 players can participate in a raid. Players must face a platter of fruity enemies to defeat, followed by Lord Melonoth himself, before they can get the amazing rewards from his raid box.

Raid Box of Lord Melonoth
The box can contain these items:

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Dear NosPlayers,

Summer is already here, and things are heating up in NosTale! As the days get longer and the temperatures rise, it’s time to reflect on what’s happened so far in 2025 and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. From major updates to blazing new servers and exciting plans for the months ahead – let’s dive in!

A Look Back: January–June 2025
Early Game Rework & Balancing
One of the most significant changes this year was our rework of the early game experience. Aimed at improving the onboarding process for new and returning players, this update brought a series of quality-of-life adjustments, revamped quest flows, and combat balancing tweaks to make early-level progression more fluid and enjoyable.

If you haven’t had the chance to check it out yet, we highly recommend taking a look at the patch notes or diving into the detailed rework document to get the full picture.

NosFire Event Server
March also saw the launch of NosFire, our limited-time event server filled with explosive action and intense boosts. Players jumped in to enjoy increased EXP and drop rates, unique progression opportunities, and a fast-paced environment that brought a fresh twist to the classic NosTale experience.

NosFire was a hit, and we’re thrilled to see how many of you took part. Whether it was for competitive goals or just to experience the rush, thank you for being part of the fun!

Looking Ahead: July–December 2025
Server Merge Incoming!
As you already know by now, one of the first updates planned for the summer is the merge of three major servers: INT-Valehir, DE-Alzanor, and FR-Cosmos. This merge will bring communities together, strengthen server populations, and create a more dynamic and competitive environment.

Summer Events – New Raid, New Adventures!
Our annual summer events return with a splash – not only can you enjoy our usual events to get your hands on hot and cool rewards, but this year, an original new event will also be deployed on our servers bringing a brand-new raid and quests as well! Expect challenging adventures against the new raid boss, succulent rewards, and all the summer vibes you can get. Prepare your team and dive into this juicy seasonal adventure!

New Content – Family Celestial Spire
Although we announced it for the first half of the year, we were sadly unable to release it on time. However, this time we’re happy to confirm that the Family Celestial Spire is now on track for release. Families will be put to the test with the introduction of the Family Ascension of the Celestial Spire – a return to the Celestial Spire from Act 7, designed for cooperative gameplay. Climb the tower together, overcome increasingly difficult floors, and earn rewards worthy of your efforts.

Anniversary Celebrations – New Temporary Celebration Server
To mark another year of NosTale, we’re launching a special temporary anniversary server packed with unique features and limited-time bonuses. Not only will you be able to enjoy the usual birthday events early this year on all servers, but you’ll also receive even more presents on the temporary server. Like NosFire, this server will also allow you to transfer your character at the end of the event – fully prepared for the major content update coming later this year!

Because remember – Christmas is still to come… and if you’re really good, Santa might bring you a really big present.

Final Words
As always, we’d like to thank every one of you for your continued support and feedback. Whether you’ve been here from the start, or are just beginning your journey in NosTale, your passion helps shape the future of the game.

See you in the game!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge: Alzanor, Cosmos & Valehir
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/12383fee94c3cbc9420f72d81942634c7ab467aa.jpg

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. We always want to ensure that you can play on servers with lots of activity. For that reason, we have decided to carry out a merge of the European servers on 16th July.

You’ll find a Merge FAQ below which should answer any important questions you may have.

The following servers are being merged together:

DE-Alzanor
FR-Cosmos
INT-Valehir

→ EU-Undercity

No changes will be made to the other server.

Server Merge FAQ

How did you decide which servers to merge together?

We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What happens if I have multiple characters on both servers which are being merged together?

You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters.

Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?

Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:

Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists.

You can change your active characters on the website at any time. This is also possible for players playing via NosTale.

What happens to families?

Active families will be transferred to the target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What happens to the family warehouse?

Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel.

What if two or more characters have the same name?

The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?

If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘\_’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 2,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?

As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?

Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?

Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character.

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?

All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?

As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target server.

Will the rankings be reset?

No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?

The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?

Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge.

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?

No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?

Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?

No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?

No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

How Fairy Upgrades Work
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

How Fairy Enchantments Work
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting levels S, A and B!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Double Event Power at the Weekend
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7963749dcc2597e2ddc519dbd7436b54c5acdf4c.jpg

We’ve got another exciting weekend lined up with two simultaneous events! Enjoy higher chances in the Partner Skill Event and get double EXP time in the Land of Life!

Event period: 2nd May (11 AM) to 5th May (11 AM CEST)

Partner Skill Event

During the event, you’ll get a +50% chance to reach higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills on regular servers. The chance is even increased to 100% on NosFire!

Whenever you upgrade a specialist partner skill, you can get one of any level, high or low. The levels are divided from highest to lowest into S, A, B, C, D, E and F. While this action cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible skill you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting levels S, A and B!

Double EXP Time in the Land of Life

During the event, you can spend up to 4 hours in the Land of Life every day. You’ll also receive about 20 minutes more to plan your entries around Asgobas’ appearance.

About the Land of Life
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance earn 100% more experience.

The Land of Life is divided into three zones: one for champion level 30–64, one for 60–82 and one for 80–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:

midnight–1:00 AM: open
1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)
2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again
... and so on

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: NosFire Event Server: Burning Hot Boosts & Action
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/55be90cfa9d48d9eb2287d3d69909cf7ff8e9864.jpg

This spring promises to be full of exciting NosTale adventures! As the Sun sends out its first warm rays of the year, we’re ready to respond with some scorching hot action. Get ready for the brand-new NosFire event server where you can level up a character faster than ever before, take advantage of events and boosts, as well as lots of other great benefits!

NosFire Event Server Starts: 15th April 2025
NosFire Event Server Ends: 18th June 2025

What to expect on the NosFire Event Server:

You’ll start at level 80 and get access to double EXP, double gold drops, and more!
You’ll get a free equipment set when you start your NosFire event server adventure!
Take part in boost events and weekend specials and make the most out of the event server!
Brand new this year: The Progress Book! Use it for a chance to get valuable rewards!
Complete missions and snag some powerful rewards with the new Battle Pass!
When the event server ends, migrate your new character to a regular server with a free character transfer and keep rocking your adventures there!
... and much more!

FAQ

Find out everything you need to know about the NosFire event server here!

How long will NosFire be online before I can transfer registered characters?

NosFire will be online for 9 weeks, from 15/4 until 18/6/2025.

What’s special about NosFire?

You can select a class in the character selection window and start at level 80/job level 80 right away.
Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.
Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosFire event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
New: You will have access to a Progress Book that will offer you lots of valuable rewards on your journey through NosFire. It works similarly to how the Pet Book works, and will allow you to access various quests from directly within the game. You can claim your rewards directly after completing the quests.
You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
Certain content, such as Act 8 raids, will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.
Cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.
Adjusted the entry level for certain Time-Spaces.
Cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.
Adjusted the entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles to level 85. Level 85+ can now access minigames.
Cannot sell or trade starting equipment.
You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.

How do I transfer my character?

Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.

How do I choose a server?

There will be various items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.

Where do I see which server I’ve selected?

You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).

Are you planning a server merge soon?

Yes, but we don’t have an exact date yet. We will inform all of you as soon as we have more details for you.

Can I take my items with me when I transfer my character?

Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
Please remember to collect all your rewards from your Battle Pass, Progress Book, and from any post before your character gets transferred. These rewards will no longer be available once the transfer is complete.

Will there be a Battle Pass?

Yes, there will be a free Battle Pass for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items, and the item transfer warehouse.

Are there rules for transferring a character?
Yes. The following rules apply:

You must select a server to transfer your character to before the NosFire event server is closed on 18th June 2025, otherwise you won’t be able to transfer your character. We will PM your character multiple times, reminding you to transfer your character before it is no longer possible to.
Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.
Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).
Bazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.
The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) apart from the Partner’s Backpack.
Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc., will also be transferred.
If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the first time you log in after transferring.
If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated. You can reactivate them in the standard manner via the website.
Any NosMall items purchased via the website that you do not collect can be collected on the destination server.
Your friends list, blacklist, and marriage will not be transferred.
All parcels (post) will be deleted during the transfer.
Please note: Any rewards you get from the Battle Pass or the Progress Book will not be transferred. Make sure to collect them before transferring.

Which boosts will be available and when?

The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:
2x XP
4x Reputation (not in Act 4)
2x XP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
2x Fairy XP
2x Gold
2x Drops
3x Family XP
In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even have multiple events.

Will there also be events on the regular servers?

Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.

Will there be an Easter event on every server?

Yes, the Easter Event will be active on every server (starting 15th April 2025).

Will there be special server first challenges?

No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.

Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?

Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Higher Starting Level and Specialist Balancing Improvements!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7ee2b2c04099f4764493dddab96ca47e15227dbf.jpg

It’s not long to go until we release our next update with lots of exciting improvements. From 19th March, it will be possible to start playing the game from a higher level! The update also brings balancing changes for a number of specialists, a raft of quality-of-life improvements, and more.

Specialist Balancing

We’ve overhauled numerous specialists to make playing the game with them more fun and give them a sprucing up. Three specialists have had a major overhaul, while a further seven have seen a number of tweaks.

There are major changes to:

Mystic Arts
Sunchaser
Warrior

Plus smaller tweaks for:

Assassin
Scout
Fire Storm
Thunderer
Tide Lord
Archmage
Voodoo Priest

Start at Level 56

As with every rookie hero in NosVille, you’ve taken your first steps into the world as an Adventurer, holding that wooden sword awkwardly in your hand, swinging it clumsily at your enemies. But those days are long behind you. As an experienced defender of NosVille, you know the ins and outs of adventuring, and have experienced all the challenges which new Adventurers need to face and could complete them with your eyes closed.
That’s why with the new update you will now be able to start out in the world of NosTale at level 56! In future you’ll have new options when creating a character, though of course you’ll still be able to start out fresh as a level-1 Adventurer if you prefer.

When creating your character you’ll find the following options in future:

Adventurer (Level 1, just as before)
Martial Artist (Level 81, only available if you already have another level-80 character)
NEW – Archer (Level 56)
NEW – Swordsman (Level 56)
NEW – Mage (Level 56)

If you choose to start at level 56, you’ll of course get some suitable gear so you can start playing straight away. You’ll have 4 fairies with the different elements, each with 30% energy, weapons (plus ammunition) and armour suitable to your class, plus your first specialist cards with resistances. And naturally you’ll have an array of skills already unlocked. Everything you need to dive straight into the adventure!

Quality-of-Life Improvements

We’ve also made several changes to improve the gaming experience in the following areas:

Some monster stats in the main quest line have been changed.
Requirements for completing certain quests have been reduced.
Party Time-Spaces can now be completed up to level 99.
The minimum level for participating in SP10 Time-Spaces has been reduced to 84.
The minimum level for climbing the Celestial Spire has been reduced to 84.

We hope you have fun exploring the changes!
The NosTale Team

We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to finally take the plunge – romantic events and fantastic rewards await! Read on to find out everything you need to know!

Valentine’s Day in NosTale

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased, while the risk of failure is reduced!

Event period: 3rd January (11 AM) to 6th January (11 AM CET)

How Fairy Upgrades Work

The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.
Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

notes.title: Community Update – First Half of 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

We’re back with our community update for the first half of 2025!

First, we’d like to wish you a prosperous new year, and a joyful 2025 spent with your loved ones. On our end, we’ll continue working hard to ensure that the content we release in NosTale meets your expectations, making this year one of the most memorable in the game’s history.

Our goal for 2025 is to enhance existing content while also bringing more fun with in-game features that our players cherish, rather than focusing solely on new systems.

But before we dive into what’s coming, let’s take a look back at everything that’s happened over the past six months.

Hardcore Raids
With the introduction of hardcore raids, we’ve released higher-difficulty content tailored to our more experienced players. These raids offer new challenges by presenting multiple harder versions of existing raids.

We’re delighted with how this update has performed and the positive reception from the community. As always, we’ll continue to listen to your feedback and make adjustments where possible to ensure you have an engaging and challenging experience while playing them.

International Server Merge and Summer Oasis Server
In August, we launched a new server designed to improve upon the usual new server you get in summer. Our goal was to provide better levelling and progression, numerous events, extra boosts, and establish INT-Valehir as the destination server to help address depopulation issues.

Initially, there was some confusion, as players expected this server to resemble the NosFire event server introduced a few months earlier. To address this, we made changes by expanding the destination servers and enhancing exclusive features on the Summer Oasis server to better align it with the NosFire experience. These adjustments clearly increased interest in the server, but also discouraged some players from transferring to INT-Valehir.

We’ve taken note of these outcomes, and you can read below to see what we have planned for the near future.

Act 4 Revamp
The most anticipated update we had in store for you this year was the Act 4 overhaul and we hope you’re enjoying the changes we’ve made.Our goal was to revitalise this content, making it more engaging for both PvE and PvP players alike.

We’ll be closely monitoring your feedback over the coming weeks to identify any adjustments that need to be made to ensure this update provides the best possible experience.

What’s to Come in 2025
Balance Update and Quality of Life Adjustments
We regularly hear your requests for more balance updates, and we’re excited to deliver!

With the next balance update, we are planning to focus on the Mystic Arts, Warrior and Sunchaser specialists.

Additionally, we are going to bring some nice quality-of-life improvements inspired by your suggestions on our Discord server. These include individual skill bars and an improved tutorial for new players, which we believe will greatly enhance the experience for beginners.

New NosFire Servers
With the NosFire servers in 2024, we received a lot of positive feedback about this kind of boosted server that made it possible for players to jump right into the higher-level experience, instead of starting from scratch.

Building on that feedback, we’re excited to announce plans for a similar server in the first half of 2025. We’ll be making some adjustments to make it even more enjoyable, so stay tuned for more updates!

Family Celestial Spire
One of the most engaging and unique pieces of content we released in recent years was Act 7’s Celestial Spire. In 2025, we want to explore this concept further, which is why we’re thrilled to announce a new version of the Celestial Spire designed for you to enjoy with your family. 

The specifics of this update are still being finalised, so keep an eye out for more details!

Summer Raid
For some time now, we’ve been hearing your feedback about wanting new seasonal content beyond our regular events for Easter, Summer, Halloween, and others. With this in mind, we have planned with Entwell to work on new concepts for seasonal content in 2025.

You’ll get to experience it this summer with an exciting new event raid. We’ll keep you posted!

Server Merges
We are fully aware of the concerns raised by INT-Valehir players regarding the server’s decreased population. While we’ve tried various methods to attract more players to the server, we recognise that the wait has been long enough. As a result, we will proceed with the much-requested INT-Valehir merge. This server will join the second international cluster alongside DE-Alzanor and FR-Cosmos.

The merge will create a server comparable in size to EU-Dragonveil, ensuring a stable population in the long term. This will provide players worldwide with two optimised servers for a better gameplay experience.

Large servers come with significant technical challenges, which is why we’re taking the time to prepare thoroughly. Once the merge date approaches, we will provide you with all the details.

We hope you’re as excited about this year’s updates as we are! Be sure to share your feedback with us on our usual platforms.Thank you all for making 2024 such an incredible year, and we can’t wait to see you in 2025!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter in NosTale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg

As you know, winter can get very cold and dreary. But not in your favourite game! In NosTale, you can expect lots of exciting events that you can hugely benefit from. Between, 10th December and 22nd January, you can look forward to a number of events such as our winter raids, special quests, awesome gifts and much more!

Winter Raids

Maru the Millennial Tiger Raid

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Completion Gemstone Random Box.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

Snowman Raid

Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward for beating this exciting raid, you’ll earn a raid box containing specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.

Winter Quests

Daily Quests

Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
Save the Siblings
Need Sesame Oil

You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

Event Quest

In these quests you can talk to the Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the wonderful items hidden inside.

Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil

Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille

Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

Happy New Year… Literally!

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.

Winter Surprises

Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer

Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

Specialist Partners

With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.
With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power.

Holiday Offers in the NosMall
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – grab the Christmas Tree Pack full of wonderful items for the holidays!

Advent Calendar in Daily Loyalty Bonus

Many festive doors are waiting to be opened by you! Between 1st December (11 AM) and 25th December (11 AM CET) you can look forward to special gifts in the daily loyalty bonus. Get into the festive Christmas spirit and pick up presents!

How It Works:

Log in daily, open a field in the NosMall and find out which surprise is waiting for you today!
During the time frame, you can get special gifts on weekends as well as one super surprise on Christmas Eve.
Remember to log in every day to get your hands on as many special gifts as you can.
Please not that the usual daily loyalty bonus gifts will not be given out during this time.

Wishing you a wonderful winter season!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 4: The Frozen Crown – The Legend Reborn!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/15330b25b4bb09a0362e3fa4d05a3738c5a7ee5f.jpg

Christmastime heralds a frosty comeback, as Act 4 returns in new glory! With thrilling new content and tasty challenges, it is time to break the ice and conquer the Frozen Crown. Monstrous opponents and legendary treasures await!

Act 4: The Legend Reawakens
Board a ship in Port Alveus and travel to Glacernon to rediscover Act 4!
PvP Combat: Fight for supremacy in epic battles and claim unique rewards.New Challenges: Defeat terrifying monsters and take on the revamped Act 4 raids which will challenge even the most accomplished of heroes.
New PvP Contribution Points
You can earn contribution points by defeating players of the enemy faction. These contribution points can then be spent to participate in Act 4 raids. To keep things frosty, the points will be reset every month.

You can only earn contribution points from players who have:
the same champion level as youa higher champion level than youa maximum of 20 champion levels below you
Players who are 21 champion levels or more below you aren’t worth any points. If you don’t have a champion level, then you are considered to have a champion level of 0. However, if you have a champion level of 1 or above, you won’t earn points from players with champion level 0. Similarly, champion level 0 players cannot earn points from players with champion level 1+.

The ranking rewards include temporary titles and items for Act 4 which are valid for 30 days. None of the titles can be traded, sold or deleted.

Revamped Act 4 Raids
Steel yourselves for the return of the challenging and rewarding raid adventures from Act 4! Here’s what to look forward to:
Revamped Raids: We’re bringing you newly tuned versions of well-known raids. The monsters and bosses will be familiar, but their stats have been adjusted.
Possible rewards:
Simple boxes or even rarity 7/8 boxesMaterials for crafting Fernon fairiesMaterials for the new shell upgrade systemThe chance to get champion level gearPerfection stones
New World Boss: Frostbite Amarok
This gigantic beast challenges you in time-limited battles. Only those who can defeat him within an hour can claim victory. Successful players will earn valuable PvP rewards.

Frostbite Amarok can be found on the map Amarok’s Hideout. The portal to the world boss opens on Mondays to Fridays at 12:30 PM, 6:30 PM, 8:30 PM and 10:30 PM CE(S)T.

When you enter the portal, all of your pets and partners will automatically be returned to your Miniland. If the boss is not defeated within 1 hour, all portals will close and there are no rewards.

The rewards consist of raid boxes containing items which mostly improve your PvP stats.

Depending on which faction deals the most damage to the boss, it will advance the progress towards opening an Act 4 raid by 25%.

The Shell Upgrade System
The new shell upgrade system brings improvements for your weapons and armour:
Collect Materials: Dismantle old shells into powder or collect Shell Stabilisers in Act 4 raids.Flexible Upgrading: Improve the effects of shells over multiple levels!New Premium Items: Manage your upgrades with exclusive tools.
A detailed overview of the changes can be found in the patch notes. Get ready for the Frozen Crown!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Great NosTombola Is Here – Every Ticket’s a Winner!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d7165ca9b687fa1c6a2c4e2a91ef80791bd0da0c.jpg

Dip your hand in the hat and seize this opportunity to grab some fantastic prizes between 4th December (11 AM) and 5th January (11:59 PM CET)!

How the NosTombola Works
Every player may take part in the NosTombola. It can be found in the NosMall in the game. There you can use tickets to win amazing prizes! Each ticket grants either one of the valuable daily jackpot prizes, a lucky token or an item as a direct prize.
You can purchase 10 tickets for NosJewels every day.Up to 6 tickets can also be purchased at a slightly cheaper price for the following day.Each new day of the NosTombola begins at 4 AM CET.
Precious NosJewels
For each purchase in the NosMall, you will be credited a certain number of NosJewels. The number of NosJewels you receive can be seen in the details in the NosMall.
You can use the NosJewels to purchase tickets, or to buy items directly in the Jewel Shop. The more tickets you use, the greater your chances to get the current day’s jackpot.

Free Daily Ticket
Don’t miss your free ticket! You can get one of these every day per account if you have completed the main quest line of Act 4 before the start of the tombola, or if you have purchased at least one ticket for three days in a row.

The Lucky Tokens
Some of the tickets have lucky tokens behind them for you to collect. Every three tokens can be exchanged for a prize. Once you collect three lucky tokens, you will receive the corresponding prize according to the total points. You can only use more tickets once this prize has been redeemed. Alternatively you can re-roll your three tokens, however this costs 20 NosDollars.

Daily Prizes
While the NosTombola is running, there are fantastic new prizes to be won every day. Come by every day and make sure you don’t miss any!

Fantastic Prizes
These and many more prizes can be won on the NosTombola:
Fairy Effect LockSteampunk WingsChampion Amulet for Increasing RarityShadow Element Steam Drone10x Champion Blessing Amulet (Random, Event)NosDollar Coupon (400)Order of HeroesOrder of DisciplinePartner Skill Upgrade Ticket
You can find more prizes, plus the prizes for the lucky tokens, in our NosTombola guide!

Please note: Once the NosTombola ends, you won't receive any more NosJewels as cashback for the purchase of NosDollars.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

Between 15th November (11 AM) and 18th November (11:00 AM CET) you can get a whopping 100% more job EXP! As if that weren’t enough, the chance to successfully upgrade your fairy is greatly increased while the risk of failure is reduced!

Fairy Upgrade

The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.
Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
Please note: Fairies which can be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
Event: During the event the chance for successful fairy upgrades will be greatly increased, while the risk of failure is reduced!

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/aaf01c57252db2aabe43c0ef31a30cfd81f7bf82.jpg

Get ready: from 23rd October until 11th November, NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

Event Raids
Jack O’Lantern and His Minions
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

Foxy and Her Brood
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

Mad Professor Macavity
The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!Full details on the raid:
Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.Players who want to play must bring a pet.Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time.Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
Daily Quests
The Cursed 13
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.Don your Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Hardcore Raids & Family Expansion - Patch notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/fa99097d7abbaf7943821e49b54024aa7eb00199.jpg

Hello everyone!

A new update has arrived which you’ve all been waiting so long far. We always try to make sure that we release each update to the highest possible quality, which is why it can sometimes take longer than you might prefer.In this update, we’re introducing hardcore versions of existing raids, an expansion to the family system, plus numerous other changes. 

There are hardcore versions for the following raids:

[table][tr][th]Act 1–3 (champion level 30+)[/th][th]Act 5 (champion level 50+)[/th][th]Act 6 (champion level 65+)[/th][th]Act 7 (champion level 80+)[/th][th]Act 8 (champion level 80+)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Mother Cuby[/td][td]Ibrahim[/td][td]Zenas[/td][td]Twisted Spirit King Kirollas[/td][td]Zombie Dragon Valehir[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ginseng[/td][td]Kertos the Demon Dog[/td][td]Erenia[/td][td]Twisted Beast King Carno[/td][td]Ice Dragon Alzanor[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dark Castra[/td][td]Valakus King of Fire[/td][td][/td][td]Demon God Belial[/td][td]Weak Asgobas[/td][/tr][tr][td]Giant Black Spider[/td][td]Fire God Grenigas[/td][td][/td][td]Evil Overlord Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td]Massive Slade[/td][td]Lord Draco[/td][td][/td][td]Revenant Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td][/td][td]Glacerus the Ice Cold[/td][td][/td][td][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]

Event raids and other temporary raids are not factored into this change, as this would mean players have fewer opportunities to collect the rewards from the current reward system. Similarly, the raids from Act 9 are not in the list as we feel that they are still new enough and do not need a special hardcore version. We may introduce these at a later juncture.

These raids have been chosen so that players have the option of playing older content in a more updated form, and are no longer forced to focus on just 1 or 2 sets of raids.

As with every update, we endeavour to make the gaming experience the best it can possibly be, but we’re also reliant on your feedback. In this update, we’ve added a new feature which will allow us to change the strength of monsters in hardcore raids on the fly, so that we can guarantee a smoother experience for you. 

This means that if certain monsters turn out to be too strong in a raid, we’ll be able to tweak their strength. We’ll take your feedback into account, as well as monitor players’ performance in the game, to make sure the raids remain both challenging and fair.

Hardcore Raids
You earn hardcore raid seals by completing the normal versions of the raids. At the moment there are no restrictions for entering hardcore raids beyond the minimum champion level. Hardcore raids can only be started with a complete team.All hardcore raids have a daily limit.The entry portals are the same as for the regular raids.The raids in Acts 1–3 require champion level 30+, raids in Act 5 champion level 50+, raids in Act 6 champion level 65+, raids in Act 7 champion level 80+, and raids in Act 8 likewise champion level 80+.Raid tokens open up a crafting window where you can craft rewards such as mini-pet versions of the raid bosses, resistances, act-specific materials and more. Mini-pets deal more damage in both the regular and hardcore versions of their raids.In all the major towns like NosVille, Dragonveil and Undercity, there will be a Raid Token Manager who can craft certain items for you like passive medals, perfection stone bags and more. The raid list will display the average champion level of the hardcore raid team.You receive a notification when you’ve inflicted enough damage to receive the rewards.
The following things change in hardcore raids
Monsters are stronger, depending on the strength of the team.There are 5/8/10 lives depending on the number of raid participants. You only have one life in hardcore raids; if you die twice, you’ll be ejected from the raid.Gold and reputation are awarded depending on the difficulty of the raid, with the gold added directly to your inventory.An additional hardcore token is awarded upon completing a hardcore raid.There is a greater chance to get raid boxes of rarity levels 7 and 8.After completing a raid, the damage statistics of the top three players who inflicted the most damage to the boss will be displayed. The stats are currently only available in hardcore raids, but may be added to normal raids in the future.You must deal a certain amount of damage to the raid boss in order to receive gold, reputation and the hardcore tokens. The raid box however is a guaranteed reward. Since it is more difficult for lower-level players to deal damage, the amount of damage they must inflict is lower than for higher-level players.Raid boxes, special items like Alzanor’s Horn, and big item drops are the same as in normal raids.
Family Expansion
The family system has been expanded to level 30, bringing new rewards with each level.There are new unique achievements awarding FXP and new passive buffs.There are new daily missions relating to hardcore raids which award FXP.The FXP requirements for levels 1–20 have been reduced by 20%.
Other Changes
The seals in Acts 1–3 can now be crafted without entering a Time-Space (as on NosFire).The Ginseng Pot now takes percentage damage per hit.Dark Castra now appears in the boss room without a delay.The ‘Damage from critical hits is increased by 300%’ effect has been removed from Massive Slade.The raid monster Slade now has magic defence.The Protection Blessing buff from Ibrahim no longer applies.There is a greater chance to get raid boxes of rarity levels 7 and 8 in Alzanor and Valehir.The gold drops in the Alzanor and Valehir raids have been increased from 30x 40,000 Gold to 60x 30,000 Gold.Several changes to the daily quests in Act 8 which provide more experience and act-related materials.Several changes to the daily quests in Act 9.1 which provide more experience and act-related materials: https://nostale.comastuff.com/HCRaids_Act_8_+_9_Changes.pdfIncreased the chance of dropping Techron’s research books, Fairy Affinity (2), Mullan Tools and Polluted Lightning Conductors.The number of items for the 17th anniversary have been reduced to 2, to save space in your inventory. As with other events, they now count as snacks and potions.You can no longer fill your basic SP from the anniversary event.Added a limit of 15,000 damage to the Sudden Twist buff.The duration of Erenia’s Curse has been reduced from 60 to 15 seconds.The Crusader Commander in Erenia’s raid now suffers percentage damage per hit.The cooldown of Zenas’ healing and monster spawn skills has been increased.Priestess Kelly of the Second Squad in Zenas’ raid now suffers percentage damage per hit.The waiting time in Zenas’ raid has been reduced from 3 minutes to 1 minute.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue which could cause dance timers to be overwritten by others.Fixed an issue where the mini-bosses in the Paimon raids wouldn’t spawn under certain circumstances.

How Fairy Upgrades Work

The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.
Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.

notes.title: End of the Summer Oasis & Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0ee3a6d0b1e6f2595a03b2e3d19de456ef768d75.jpg

As the summer draws to a close, it’s time to bid farewell to our Summer Oasis server. As previously announced when we launched the server, there will be a server merge on Wednesday, 25th September 2024. All characters will by default be transferred to the Valehir server, though it is possible to choose a different server using an item.

In order to answer some of your most important questions in advance, here’s our list of server merge FAQs.

Server Merge FAQ

Where can I see which server I have selected?
You can see your chosen server in the Consumables tab (where your NosBazaar medals and expansions are shown).
Can I transfer my items with my character?
All items will be automatically transferred.The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.The contents of regular warehouses will be sent per parcel to the characters with the highest level.Bazaar contents will be sent per parcel to the characters with the highest level, and gold from already sold items will be sent to the character.As per normal, there is a gold limit of 2,000,000,000 gold on the merged server. If you have more than this before the merge, it will be reduced to the limit. If you lose gold during the merge, please contact our Support team.
How can I transfer my character?
All characters will be automatically transferred to the server Valehir.In order to choose a different destination server, you need the item which can be acquired from the Battle Pass reward (level 13).Characters who have chosen a different destination server will be transferred to their chosen server along with all other Summer Oasis characters on the same account.
How can I choose my destination server?
There will be five different items, each representing a different destination server, which allow you to choose your server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the Summer Oasis server closes to choose your destination server.Please note: The item for the locked server Jotunheim still exists, but if you choose this item, you will be transferred to Valehir.
Are there any rules for transferring?
Certainly! The following rules apply:
You must select a destination server before the Summer Oasis server goes offline, otherwise your character will be transferred to Valehir by default.All items in your regular inventory will be transferred automatically.Families will not be transferred. The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.Gold will be transferred (including the bank).Bazaar auctions will be ended and sent to characters per parcel.The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) including the Partner’s Backpack.Your character’s progress including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class etc. will also be transferred.If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the next time you log in after transferring.If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated and you can activate them in the standard manner via the website.Uncollected NosMall items can be collected on the destination server.Friends list, blacklist and marriage will not be transferred.All parcels will be transferred.

notes.title: Summer Oasis Server Starts Today!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7f48d48b3bcb0022ec77e13307525d7bed8766ac.jpg

Have you packed your suitcases for this magical break? Today sees the launch of the Summer Oasis server and the start of the summer adventure in NosTale!

As already mentioned in our first announcement , on this special international server you’ll benefit from permanent boosts, special weekend events, a free Battle Pass and much more. At the end of the server, it will be merged into the Valehir server.


Summer Oasis server starts: 7th August 2024
Summer Oasis server ends: 25th September 2024

Boosts, Events & Achievements
Here are all the details on the boosts, events and achievements to look forward to on the Summer Oasis server!

Permanent Boosts
These boosts are permanently active on the server:

2x EXP
2x Gold
2x Drops
4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)
2x Fairy EXP
2x Family EXP
2x XP for fishing, cooking and training pets

Events

The Battle Pass is available for free! Complete exciting missions to earn useful items for your adventures.
In a few days, the Sealed Vessel Event will begin! Are you ready to open the vessels and take on the enemies who pop out of them? Victorious fighters can look forward to awesome treasure chests!

Achievements

During the Summer Oasis, you’ll find a special website at https://nostale.comastuff.com/OasisAchievements/Achievements.php?lang=en, where you can see a list of all the achievements which can be unlocked. Click on an achievement to see the reward in the top right, and below that, a list of players who’ve already unlocked it.
Each achievement is limited to a maximum of 5 or 10 players (excluding achievements for raid parties, which are for the fastest group).
Please note that only the things you do on the Summer Oasis server count towards these achievements.

Achievements are divided into four categories:

Solo Achievements: You can complete these individually.
Raid Party Achievements: For these, you’ll need to be in a raid party.
Server Achievements: These include all achievements which can be completed server-wide.
Completed Achievements: Here you’ll see all the achievements which have already been completed.

In addition to the achievements listed on the website, there are also three special achievements:

Reach a top 10 ranking for the highest reputation (excluding Act 4) by 28th August.
Reach a top 10 ranking for the most points in Act 4 by 28th August.
Reach a top 10 ranking for the most victories in the Arena of Talents/Arena of Masters by 28th August.

Please note that the website will be updated at regular intervals, and it may take some time before unlocked achievements appear as ‘completed’.

Once you unlock an achievement, you’ll receive various rewards such as great titles or prized tame pets! Please be aware however that while our little delivery bushi will be working hard to deliver all the rewards, it may take a couple of days before your receive your items.


Server Merge
On 25th September 2024, the Summer Oasis server will come to an end, and all characters, together with all of the content they’ve unlocked, will be transferred to the international server Valehir. More details will be released shortly before the server merge.


Enjoy the summer!
The NosTale Team
