notes.title: Summer Oasis Server: Magical Break
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7f48d48b3bcb0022ec77e13307525d7bed8766ac.jpg

Are the sun’s rays beating down on your back? Does the ice cream no longer cool you down? Yet you’re still looking for more action and excitement? Then get ready for a summer of adventure in NosTale, as the Summer Oasis will soon open its gates!

On this special server, you’ll benefit from permanent boosts, special weekend events, a free Battle Pass and much more. At the end of the server, it will be merged into the Valehir server.
Summer Oasis server starts: 7th August 2024Summer Oasis server ends: 25th September 2024
The Summer Oasis

Dive in and enjoy a paradise of action! Look forward to the following highlights:

Boosts & Weekend Events
During the entire Summer Oasis, you can look forward to increased experience points, more gold, and other permanent boosts.Each weekend there are exclusive events with higher drop and enchantment chances, which will make your heroic journey even more exciting and worthwhile.

Free Battle Pass
Complete missions in the free Battle Pass to earn items which will support you on your adventures and accelerate your progress.

Special Achievements
For the most dedicated adventurers, the Summer Oasis offers additional challenges and achievements. These can be completed either alone or in a group, and reward you with exclusive items and titles.In addition there are server-wide challenges for the entire community. Work together to complete these to unlock even better boosts during the weekend events!

Your Summer Bootcamp
Use the Summer Oasis to prepare for the new content coming later this year – the challenging hardcore mode for raids! We’ll be releasing more details at a later date... but you can already start preparing now!

Summer Oasis Server FAQ

Here’s a short FAQ about the Summer Oasis server:

What’s special about the Summer Oasis?
The Summer Oasis is an international server with special events that will be merged into the international server Valehir after one and a half months.The server will offer permanent boosts, as well as two additional weekend boosts which are higher than usual, making it possible for you to progress faster and easier.There will be a free Battle Pass on the Summer Oasis server which rewards you with in-game items based on the missions completed. These rewards include amulets, consumables, lifestyle specialist items, costumes and more.On top of all that, there will be specific challenges and achievements on the Summer Oasis to reward the most loyal and motivated adventurers with exclusive items. The achievements can be individual or group-based (players being rewarded with titles and all manner of other great items), and there will even be server-wide challenges! For example, if the server manages to master a certain challenge, then all players will enjoy higher boosts during the weekend event. The more you achieve, the greater the rewards for everyone!
What boosts will be available and when?
The following boosts will be permanently active during the Summer Oasis:
2x EXP2x Gold2x Drops4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)2x Fairy EXP2x Family EXP2x XP for fishing, cooking and training petsIn addition there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box and upgrade events, which are even better than usual. There will also be weekends when more than one event is active.
Will there be special achievements?
Yes, the more players on the server achieve, the better you will all be rewarded! Details on the achievements and rewards will be revealed shortly before the server launches.

When will the Summer Oasis server be merged with Valehir?
The Summer Oasis will be merged into Valehir on 25th September 2024.

What will happen to my characters? Will I lose anything?
No, all characters on the Summer Oasis server, including their items and progress, will be transferred to Valehir. There are no restrictions as to the number of characters. Please check our previous Valehir server merge as the same rules will apply in this case: https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/1056-server-merge-valehir-jotunheim/

Can I select my destination server at the end like with the NosFire server?
No, all characters will be transferred to Valehir by default.

Can I change my character name on the Summer Oasis server?
Yes, you can do exactly the same things you can do on all other servers.

Will events still be taking place on the other servers?
Yes, the other servers will have the same weekend events as Summer Oasis, but with lower percentage increases.

Enjoy the summer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Welcome once again to the mid-year community update!

First Half of 2024: A Review

Before sharing what’s coming in the second half of 2024, we would like to discuss our experience with the content launched in recent months. We know that communication is very important to you, a topic we’ve discussed extensively on platforms like Discord. Therefore, we want to expand these biannual updates with more information about our most relevant projects.

Act 9

Shortly before this year began, Act 9 Part 1 – Secrets of the Undercity arrived, introducing new quests, levels, an underground world with new maps and monsters, two challenging raids, fresh gear, and an enhanced fairy system. With each new act, our goal is to continue expanding the wonderful world of NosTale and provide a new dose of fun, exploration, and exciting battles.

However, areas, instances, and enemies are not the only things we have worked on this first half of the year. In June, we released Act 9 Part 2 – Heroes of the Undercity, which brought a new generation of specialist cards with innovative mechanics and a new raid boss which will test your preparation for the end-game.

Quality of Life Changes

With the latest update, we have implemented several modifications to various aspects and systems of the game. These include adjustments to Pollutus and Giant Arma’s mechanics, and better rewards in raid boxes from Act 8 and 9 raids. We have also increased the drop rates of several items such as Mystic Power Crystals and Moritius Obsidian, as well as upping the gold limit in the NosBazaar and player inventory, among other changes.

Many quality-of-life changes have been introduced with this release. Some updates contain more noticeable changes than others, but this remains an important aspect of every addition to the game, so we appreciate you continuing to send us your suggestions and ideas via Discord.

NosFire Event Servers

This Easter we introduced a new kind of event – the NosFire temporary event server. This event server was designed to help returning and new players quickly catch up with end-game content. Thanks to your motivation, the first edition was an amazing success, and we greatly appreciate all your positive feedback about it. We will evolve it based on your comments for a future edition, also adding some more surprises to spice things up.

International Servers

Recently, we also merged the two international servers to ensure a balanced population across all servers, although some might have preferred different plans.

While a mega-server with all communities might seem appealing, it would likely lead to overcrowding and a worse experience. Rest assured, the other servers remain well-populated, and we will continue to monitor server numbers closely.

Second Half of 2024: What to Expect

For the second half of this year, you will notice some familiar content, some expected changes, as well as a few surprises. We want to ensure that the content we release meets both your expectations and our own high standards, so we won’t provide specific dates, just an overview. As we approach each release date, we will share more detailed information, so stay tuned to our channels!

NosTale is more alive than ever and will continue to receive updates actively. With all that said, here’s what’s coming in 2024!

Hardcore Raids

The main novelty for the second half of this year will be Hardcore Raids, new content designed to test the skills of the most advanced players. The current game raids will have a version with increased difficulty, which will require special conditions to access.

Additionally, this update will include a series of changes to systems closely related to raids, such as an increased family level, new family achievements, and a renewed token shop with exciting rewards.

Summer Oasis

Speaking of servers and merges, we can already inform you that this summer, a new special server will be available to welcome adventurers and help them progress faster. It will combine elements from NosFire, such as double events during weekends and the extra boosts that you enjoyed, along with a planned merge after a set period! This ensures that fresh characters are swiftly prepared for the hardcore raids, new specialists, and end-game challenges. More information will be provided as we approach the server launch.

Rework of Act 4

We know how eager you were for the Act 4 update, so it is especially satisfying for us to announce its arrival in 2024. There are still many details to be finalised about the definitive content, so at the moment, we cannot offer you a preview of what it will entail. What we can tell you is that our goal with this update is to revitalise the act’s content, making it relevant again for players in both PvE and PvP.

Quality of Life Improvements

As mentioned earlier, we greatly appreciate all the suggestions you send us on Discord. They are a valuable source of information about the state of the game and which content is most important for us to update and improve. Thanks to this feedback, we have prepared a series of quality-of-life improvements focused on some of the most relevant suggestions you have conveyed to us via the platform.

Seasonal Events

And of course, we will continue to have our regular seasonal content, including Summer, Anniversary, Halloween, and Christmas events.

As always, we appreciate all the comments you share about the community updates, and we look forward to reading your impressions on Discord, Reddit, and the forums. All feedback is welcome!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge: Valehir & Jotunheim
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0ee3a6d0b1e6f2595a03b2e3d19de456ef768d75.jpg

NosPlayers, your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. We always want to ensure that you can play on servers with lots of activity. For that reason, we have decided to carry out a merge of the UK/EN servers.

You’ll find a Merge FAQ below which should answer any important questions you may have.

The following servers are being merged together:
EN 4 (INT-Valehir)EN 6 (INT-Jotunheim)
→ EN 4 (INT-Valehir)

No changes will be made to any other servers.

Server Merge FAQ

How did you decide which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What happens if I have multiple characters on both servers which are being merged together?
You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial ArtistsThree slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial ArtistsAll four slots will be occupied by your characters.

Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial ArtistsIf you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThree slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThe slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:

Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists.
You can change your active characters on the website at any time. This is also possible for players playing via NosTale.

What happens to families?
Active families will be transferred to the target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What happens to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel.

What if two or more characters have the same name?
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 2,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 2,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character.

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target server.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target server will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge.

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

Event period: 28th June (11 AM) to 1st July (11 AM CEST)

How Fairy Upgrades Work

The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.
Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

notes.title: New International Forum
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

NosTale is moving to a new forum!

In recent years, the platforms used by the community to interact with each other have been changing organically, according to the new needs of users and advancing technical possibilities and innovations. In addition, the global nature of the internet has led us to connect with people beyond our borders, making it common for almost any online community to be made up of people from different countries and languages.

These facts have led to forums, as they were conceived years ago, losing activity in favour of other more accessible or international platforms like Discord and Reddit. However, we know that forums remain an important tool with regards to informative content, so we want to update their functionality so that they continue to be relevant today.

That’s why we’ve decided to open a new forum for NosTale, focused on those aspects where forums still bring great value and in which they are hard to replace.

What to Expect from This New Forum

To start with, the new NosTale forum will bring together seven of our communities: International, Czech, French, Italian, Polish, Spanish and Turkish. This means that these communities’ old forums will be put into read-only mode and it will not be possible to register new accounts, create new threads or reply to them. This status of the old forums will last some time until the influx of users has been channelled to the new forum and some of the information stored there has been transferred to the new forum. Once this process is complete, the old forums will be closed and will no longer be accessible.

As mentioned above, the focus of the new forum will be on informative content. On the one hand, all news will continue to be published in all languages as before, and this will also be the RSS source for Discord announcements. On the other hand, we want to make the guides section a place where people regularly go to get useful information about the game and how our different platforms work.

But that’s not all. The ability to express oneself openly is fundamental on any internet platform, so while some categories that existed in the old forums will no longer be there (such as bug reports, suggestions, family search or business, which have a greater reach on Discord with other departments involved), other categories such as help, discussions, creative content and off-topic will continue to have their place, so players can continue to interact and share their opinions and passions with others.

It’s also worth giving special mention to the artistic content, such as fan art and creative writing. You have the possibility to move your drawings and stories from the old forums to the new one, while they are still accessible in read-only mode. We highly appreciate the content which the community has contributed to the game over all these years, and we would like at least part of its history to accompany us on this new journey. If you need help from the forum team to carry this out, don’t hesitate to contact us through the support system.

With all that said... the new forum is now open! You can access it via the following link: https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/. We invite you to register and share your feedback about the current structure, any changes or improvements you would make, and most importantly, participate in the way you enjoy the most.

Enjoy your new home!
The NosTale Team

You must take on the imps Hongbi and Cheongbi in their raid. The two of them summon little clones of themselves to make your life hell. Put paid to these monsters and pick up the specialist partner cards from the raid box!

The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance earn 100% more experience.

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased, while the risk of failure is reduced!

Event period: 22nd March (11 AM) to 25th March (11 AM CET)

How Fairy Upgrades Work

The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
Success: Your fairy gets a random effect.
Failure: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
Overcharge: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

notes.title: NosFire Event Server FAQ
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/ce64626128920a7864c52384d78a6b206beeff98.jpg

Find out everything you need to know about the NosFire event server here!

How long will NosFire be online before registered characters can be transferred?

NosFire will be online for 9 weeks, between 25th March and 28th May 2024.

What is special about NosFire?

All characters start at level 80/job level 20, with quest progress starting in Act 4.
When you select a class, you automatically reach job level 80.
Once you’ve selected a class, various items will be added to your inventory. These include equipment sets 5+7, resistances and fairies all bound to your character, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.
You can transfer a character to a chosen destination server at the end of the event server.
Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts which are higher than normal will be active on the NosFire event server. These allow you to progress faster and easier.
There will be copies of the most popular levelling maps on the same map.
Certain content such as Act 8 raids will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.
You can immediately craft low-level raid seals without completing Time-Spaces.
The Arena of Talents will be disabled on NosFire.
You cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.
The entry level for certain Time-Spaces will be adjusted.
You cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.
The entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles has been changed to level 85.
The sales value of starting equipment has been reduced to a minimum.
The Land of Death and Land of Life will be available to enter as usual. Instant Combats will be available on all channels.

How can I transfer my character?

Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. This requires an item available as a higher Battle Pass reward which allows you to select your target server. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred.

How can I choose my destination server?

There will be five different items, each representing a different destination server, which allow you to choose your server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.

Where can I see which server I have selected?

You can see your chosen server in the Consumables tab (where your NosBazaar medals and expansions are shown).

Are any server merges planned soon?

Yes, a short while after the end of the NosFire event server, the INT-Valehir and INT-Jotunheim servers are going to be merged (currently slated for June 2024). We will inform you in due course if there are any changes to the plan, and announce the specific date.

Can I transfer my items with my character?

All items that you character currently has equipped (in the P window) will be automatically transferred. In the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Everything else will not be transferred.

Will there be a Battle Pass?

Yes, there will be a free Battle Pass for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to earlier seasons, giving you a chance to quickly catch up and make progress easier.
You can unlock the following items amongst others in the Battle Pass: Caligor’s Spirit, upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items and the item transfer warehouse.

Are there any rules for transferring?
Certainly! The following rules apply:

Until the end of the NosFire event server on 28th May 2024 you must have chosen a destination server, otherwise you character cannot be transferred. We will send several private messages to your character to remind you of the transfer in good time.
All items that you character currently has equipped (in the P window) will be automatically transferred. In the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Everything else will not be transferred.
Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.
Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).
Bazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.
The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) with exception of the Partner’s Backpack.
Your character’s progress including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class etc. will also be transferred.
If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the next time you log in after transferring.
If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated and you can activate them in the standard manner via the website.
Uncollected NosMall items purchased via the website can be collected on the destination server.
Friends list, blacklist and marriage will not be transferred.
All parcels (post) will be deleted during the transfer.

What boosts will be available and when?

The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:
2x EXP
4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)
2x XP for fishing, cooking and training pets
2x Fairy XP
2x Gold
2x Drops
4x Family XP
In addition there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, bringing even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.

Will there also be events on the regular servers?

Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.

Will there be an Easter event on all servers?

Yes, the Easter Event will be active on all servers (starting 25th March 2024).

Will there be special server first challenges?

No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.

Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?

Unfortunately this isn’t possible for technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to your account being restricted.

Can I create characters on both event servers with the same account and transfer them both to regular servers at the end?

No, unfortunately no. The character transfer can only be received as a Battle Pass reward, and is only available for one character per account.

Info & Patch notes
More information and detailed patch notes will be published shortly.

notes.title: Community Update – First Half of 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Dear NosPlayers,

Welcome to our latest Community Update!

As we have been doing for several years, we are going to share with you our plans for the game for the first half of 2024. Please note that the individual points are not sorted according to their planned release date and, while our goal is to bring you all of these updates by June at the latest, they may have to be postponed to a later date if any unforeseen problems arise. However, we are optimistic about our current schedule and hope that the next six months will be as exciting as they appear.

Act 9, Part 2
We already gave you a little preview of this in the Act 9 livestream; the Undercity will see its content expanded in 2024, with a second part bringing some important additions, such as a new raid boss, new specialist cards for all classes, plus an update to the Land of Life which will provide a new space for levelling up to champion level 90.

Server Merges
Merging servers is a topic that some of you broach with us quite regularly, and we understand your concerns on this matter, so we will be monitoring server activity and data over the coming months to decide on how to approach this, and which servers should be involved.

Seasonal Events
The content we have mentioned will come in addition to our seasonal events, which will provide you with playable content throughout the year on a regular basis. We have already started with the Lunar New Year Event, which will be followed by events for Valentine’s Day and Easter.

Quality of Life Improvements
We still pay close attention to the suggestions you send us via Discord, with all the feedback on the current balance between the various specialist cards. We understand that in addition to great content, even the little details help to make the game even better, so we already have in mind some updates of this kind which we plan to release over the coming months.

New Community Forum
Although Discord is currently the most important hub of activity for the community, the forums still play an important role as a place for looking up information about the game: news, guides, discussions, help, among other things. For this reason, we are going to have a new forum in NosTale for the International, Czech, French, Italian, Polish, Spanish, and Turkish communities, which we will focus on as an information resource with updated guides and all relevant news.

We’d love to hear your thoughts on what’s to come, and we invite you to share your first impressions with us on our Discord server or our subreddit!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter in NosTale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg

As you know, winter can get very cold and dreary. But not in your favourite game! In NosTale, you can expect lots of exciting events that you can hugely benefit from. Between, 11th December and 17th January, you can look forward to a number of events such as our Winter Raids, special quests, awesome gifts and much more!


Winter Raids

Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Completion Gemstone Random Box.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

Snowman Raid
Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward for beating this exciting raid, you’ll earn a raid box containing specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.


Winter Quests
Daily Quests

Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
Save the Siblings
Need Sesame Oil

You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

Event Quest
In these quests you can talk to the Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the wonderful items hidden inside.

Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

Happy New Year… Literally!
Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.


Winter Surprises

Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer
Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

Specialist Partners
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger. 
With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power.

Holiday Offers in the NosMall
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – including a festive Miniland decoration! 

Wishing you a wonderful winter season!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 9 – Secrets of the Undercity
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b7bad622a11205360c4675d3e97709f8883ff793.jpg

The time has come – a new adventure has begun! In Act 9 – Secrets of the Undercity, NosTale’s heroes will venture deep into the underground world of a mysterious race of people. Look forward to a host of new content, including quests, maps, raids, Time-Spaces, equipment, new opponents, NPCs, an improved fairy system and much more!


The Story
The Mine Plains near NosVille have suddenly come under attack by a mysterious army. According to reports, the frog-like Mullans have unexpectedly emerged from the depths of the earth. The guards are barely managing to keep the army at bay, and the threat is far from over... 

Now it is up to you! Will you venture into the menacing caverns to uncover the secrets of this subterranean people? Unravel the mysteries, complete more than 100 newly added quests and defeat new enemies!


Two New Raids
Put your skills to the test in the new raids, defeating menacing monsters to loot powerful equipment!

Giant Arma Raid

For up to 12 players
Requires champion level 80+
Location: Secret Lab
Entry: Requires Giant Arma’s Raid Seal

Pollutus Raid

For up to 8 players
Requires champion level 80+
Location: Polluted Area 2
Entry: Requires Moss Giant Pollutus’ Raid Seal

New Equipment
Having the right gear can make all the difference between victory and defeat. In Act 9 you can finally get your hands on some shiny new equipment, with a new set of weapons and armour available for every class! You can also loot other items such as helmets, boots, gloves and various accessories.


Improved Fairy System
Your fairies get a sizeable boost in this update, allowing you to upgrade them from level 0 to 9! Each upgrade gives them an additional random effect (Level C to S). Plus you can use fairy betting (random) to level up or change existing effects.


Patch Notes
That’s not all that Act 9 has to offer. You can find full details on the update in our exhaustive patch notes .


Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/5b925cb8a05fafb960c716ea3c840bffbd68eb6e.jpg

Get ready: from 25th October until 8th November, NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

Event Raids

Jack O’Lantern and His Minions

Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

Foxy and Her Brood

Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

Mad Professor Macavity

The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!
Full details on the raid:
Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.Players who want to play must bring a pet.Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects

In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
Daily Quests

The Cursed 13

Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs

Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. notes.title: Gear Up with the Battle Pass!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b9405847c675ee5c47b7a443363371b8526efc5f.jpg

Enjoy all the benefits of our brand-new Battle Pass on the new international NosTale server Jotunheim! Find out all the details about your favourite game’s newest feature in this post.

What Is the Battle Pass?

The NosTale Battle Pass gives you lots of daily, weekly, and seasonal challenges to master, and you’ll earn Battle Points by completing them. The points you earn can then be exchanged for some amazing items. And everyone can benefit: Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

Each Battle Pass season lasts for about 6 weeks (but this isn’t a hard and fast rule). But even if you miss a few missions from the current season, you’ll still have the chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward from the remaining activities. 

Rewards: Battle Pass rewards include a wide variety of cool items, including the NosMerchant Medal (7 Days), Equipment Protection Scroll, a new exclusive title, 20x Perfume and more!

Don’t Miss Out on Premium Rewards!

If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for those players who want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

For just 250 NosDollars, you can pick up the Premium Battle Pass which is valid for one season.For those who don’t have much time on their hands, there’s also the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall, which you can use to skip ahead and earn yourself 50 Battle Points. The coin is available from season week 3.

Rewards: Among the premium-level rewards, you can find such goodies as the NosMerchant Medal (30 Days), 2x Golden Equipment Protection Scroll, 80x Perfume, the exclusive Tamed Jellyfish pet and many more high-quality prizes!

notes.title: New International Server and Battle Pass – Get Ready for Summer in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6b06d3d1a8a7ef40c4a4ece8a2cf0614f9a17356.jpg

Dear player,

We hope you’re ready for a new place to run around in and even more action: NosTale will have a new international server!

The launch of the server also marks the start of the Battle Pass season. For six weeks, you will receive special rewards for completing tasks and earning Battle Points – and even more with the Premium Battle Pass!

The new international server won’t have any language region restrictions. That means you can make an exciting new start, and experience everything in your own language, thanks to the multi-language client.

In case you haven’t heard about our multi-language client or the Battle Pass yet, here are some FAQs that will explain everything you need to know:


International Server and Battle Pass FAQ

What language will the new server support?

Everyone playing on the international server will have the ability to play in their own language. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on things, and may choose to establish a chat language at a later date.

What language will ticket support be in?

The international server's ticket support will be available in the same languages as on the EU-Dragonveil server.

Where can I go to discuss server-related things?

We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord. And, if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

Are you planning anything special for the server launch?

Yes, the Battle Pass mentioned above will only be available on this server. The new pet and title inside the Battle Pass are therefore only available on the new server.

Do I have to buy the Premium Battle Pass to get Battle Pass rewards?

The Battle Pass also includes free rewards, but with the Premium Battle Pass you will, of course, receive more and more valuable rewards.

I’m still not sure. Can I also buy the Premium Battle Pass later?

Of course. You will retroactively receive all rewards that you have unlocked with your Battle Points.

Do I have to complete every single task to get the main prize?

No, your Battle Points should be enough even if skip a mission or two.

But my Battle Points are not enough! What now?

If you don’t have enough time or some missions are too difficult, you can buy the Premium Battle Pass Coin using NosDollars to increase your Battle Points. The coin will be available three weeks after the beginning of the season.

What if the Battle Pass season ends but I don’t have time to collect my rewards?

Don’t worry! After the end of the season, you’ll have another two weeks to collect your rewards.

notes.title: Community Update – Second half of 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Greetings, NosPlayers!

Summer has arrived and, as every year around this time, we’d like to share with you a new edition of the community update!

During this first half of the year, we have implemented several quality-of-life adjustments, balance adjustments for some specialist cards, merged Cylloan with the international servers (finally!), revived the NosTale subreddit (r/nostale 😉) and launched the Pet Trainer SP, which is undoubtedly the biggest update so far in 2023. However, our roadmap doesn’t end here, and there are still big things coming up until 2024. Want to know more? Then read on!

In addition to the above, one of the more subtle but useful changes we’ve made is the Discord feedback process, which helps us to find out what you as a community really want from the game and get that feedback to the company more quickly. This has allowed us to work on more and better quality-of-life adjustments that we have planned for the coming months.

But these quality-of-life tweaks are not the only ones! Another of your most frequent requests is for balance adjustments to the specialist cards. Unfortunately, we cannot confirm which SPs will be adjusted next, as some SPs will see more significant changes than others, and choosing which ones to go with first will depend on other content we are releasing at the same time. However, we are confident that the next round of balance changes will meet your expectations.

And those tweaks aren’t the only thing we’re bringing back – the Battle Pass is also making a return! In the coming weeks, we will be kicking off a new season, which will be the start of a very busy end of 2023! We also have more Battle Passes planned for the rest of the year, which should cover most of the period from July to December, giving you useful rewards and exclusive items.
One of these Battle Passes will be launched together with a new international server at the end of the summer. This will be a great incentive for those players who want to make a strong start on this new server, in addition to the special events we will be organising to reward the most daring adventurers.

As we have done in the first half of the year, we will continue to improve the rewards of the seasonal events to meet the current needs of our players.. Speaking of events, we would like to highlight the Anniversary event that will take place in October. It will be the biggest event of the year and will be accompanied by a new community contest – after all, how could we not go all out in celebrating NosTale’s 16th birthday!

And what better way to close out this community update than with new content! The fairy system has been intact for a couple of years now, and we’ve had several suggestions for changes to reignite your interest in it, so we thought it was time to show our little fairies some love with an update we’re sure you’ll love. Stay tuned for more updates!

Wow… with everything we’ve just told you, it feels like Christmas has come early! Speaking of which, if you’re on your best behaviour, Santa Claus might bring you a huge present this year...

See you next time!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Funktastic Monster Hunt
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/033e0d016a71e632434353688ed6d646b26efc68.jpg

The renowned scientist Dr Funkenstein has been beavering away in his laboratory, experimenting on ways to make pets even stronger. But he’s taken a dangerous path, using controversial techniques to splice their DNA together with strands from some of the more powerful monsters out there! He was on the cusp of making a major breakthrough, when something terrible happened… a loud bang, a fizz of sparks, and his entire experiment went up in smoke! Don’t worry, Dr Funkenstein is unharmed, but now all of his test subjects are running wild. That’s right, genetically modified monsters which could attack at any moment!

It’s now up to you to track down the runaway beasties. Dr Funkenstein is willing to offer you a generous reward for your help. (If you don’t help, he’ll have to pay a massive fine for his illegal experiments and for endangering the lives of young adventurers.)

Event Period: From 5th July (11 AM) to 12th July (9 AM CEST).

Let the Hunt Begin

Search for Dr Funkenstein and the monsters on channel 7 – here’s what you need to do:
Find the right map where the monsters are lurking.Be in the right place at the right time, because the monsters will only come out at certain times.Defeat the monsters, but be on your guard. They’re very strong and liable to use unusual attacks.The monsters drop special loot you can take to Dr Funkenstein for valuable rewards.Team up with other adventurers to hunt the monsters down more effectively.
The monsters drop the loot to the ground – the player or group that dealt the first damage can pick it up. Please note that the loot cannot be traded and that the monsters’ health slowly diminishes, causing them to disappear after a few minutes.

Find the Monsters

Here are a few tips for tracking down the monsters (only Act 1, 2, 3 and 5):
Foxies like hiding in caves.Woolies enjoy munching grass and often hang around experimental facilities.Imps are attracted to magical areas.Jellies are most liable to be found in sandy regions.Hamsters like temples and ruins.Wolves prefer the shade of mountains and woods.

notes.title: Game Update: Become an Expert Pet Trainer!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b0738846590b28dcb7cf7ae361e01073916bd40d.jpg

Get ready for the new update on 23rd May 2023! Train your pets and become the best Pet Trainer in all of NosVille! Collect pets in your Pet Book, evolve them and receive unique rewards! Get started right away and visit Pet Trainer Lucy in NosVille. Her Pet Trainer quest line will guide you through the first steps as a Pet Trainer. (You need to have reached at least level 80.)

New Lifestyle Specialist Card: Pet Trainer

With the new specialist card, you can tame monsters and train them as pets in your Miniland to make them even stronger. Here’s how it works:
Tame a monster or buy a pet.Summon various Sparring Monsters to train your pets.Depending on its training level, the pet has certain skills.When a pet has reached the maximum training level, you can increase its star rating with the Evolve skill (from 1 to 6 stars).To increase the star rating, you need the corresponding Pet Essence. (Example: If you want to upgrade a 2-star pet, you’ll need the Pet Essences of a 2-star pet.)To get Pet Essences, you need to tame and train another pet with the same star rating until it has reached its maximum training level.Extract the Pet Essence from the pet. (The pet is released in the process.)Now you can use the extracted Pet Essences and some gold to increase the star rating of the first pet.When you increase a pet’s star rating, it will forget all of its skills and the training level will be reset to 1, but at the same time its maximum training level will be increased.
Tame Pets
Pet Trainers have two skills they can use to catch animals: ‘Tame’ and ‘Advanced Tame’. You can only tame 1 and 2-star creatures with skills. The Tame skill can be used for 1-star animals, while Advanced Tame is needed for 2-star animals.Advanced Tame needs a particular item for you to use it: Lure.Bring the necessary ingredients to Lucy in NosVille and she’ll craft Lure.
Train Pets
To train your pets, you need to summon one of three various Sparring Monsters. For this you need a Sparring Monster Cage, which you can buy from Lucy.The first Sparring Monster trains your pets to level 20, the second to level 40 and the third to level 60.When a pet’s training level increases, its HP, attack power, defence, hit rate and all resistances increase as well. Plus at certain levels it can learn special skills.A pet can have a maximum of two additional skills. Any skills it has already learned can be upgraded at random.At training levels 10 and 20, the pet learns one new skill each. At further training levels (30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60), a skill that has already been learned is upgraded at random.
Star Rating & Training Level
Every pet can evolve from 1 to 6 stars. Your training level depends on this (maximum training level = star rating x 10).You get a fixed stat per training level (e.g. defence, HP, attack, etc.)
Pet Book
Here you can see which pets there are and which ones you have already collected and trained. In addition, there are missions that you can complete to receive special rewards. You can also complete daily quests here.
Rewards
Titles: You will receive various titles for completing some of the quests from the Pet Book.Passive skill books: Some quests from the Pet Book reward you with passive skill books.
Patch Notes

Learn all about the content of the update in our patch notes!

Best of luck on your way to becoming an expert trainer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some English-language servers together – including the US server.

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

We've merged the following servers together:

 EN2 (US-Cylloan)
EN 4 (INT-Valehir)
EN 5 (INT-Asgobas)
→ EN 4 (INT-Valehir)

No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

Server Merge FAQ

How did you decide which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What languages can I use on the server INT-Valehir, and what language will Support use?
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire server. Support will only be available in english.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 

Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:

Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
Click on Settings to open your game account settings containing region and language settings and a list of all your game accounts.
Ensure you have selected English [GB] as your game language and click on settings next to your game account name. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. 

You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

What’s happening to families?
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What’s happening to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What if two or more characters have the same name?
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact the Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 


If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

How did you decide which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What languages can I use on the server INT-Valehir, and what language will Support use?
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire server. Support will only be available in english.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 

Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:

Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. 

You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

What’s happening to families?
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What’s happening to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What if two or more characters have the same name?
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact the Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 


If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update: Balancing for Specialist Cards
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64e16e69ca7f645076651dfdccb5d1abcbd989a1.jpg

Heads up, NosHero! The next update arrives on 15th March 2023 – and along with it loads of exciting content: discover the new balancing for several specialist cards as well as a bunch of improved game features! Read on to find out everything you need to know.


Balancing for Specialist Cards

Get ready for exciting battles, because the following specialist cards will receive improved balancing with the upcoming update:

Master Wolf
The way his ultimate abilities work has been fundamentally changed so that each of them now serves an individual purpose. From now on, you collect points for each skill hit and receive the ‘Ultimate Aura’ by activating the ultimate skills. At the highest level, you can use your ‘Ultimate Tri-Combo’ to destroy your opponents!

Holy Mage
The healing of the Holy Mage now scales with his own maximum HP: the stronger you are, the more you can heal your allies! In addition, some of his skills have been reworked to offer even more support in the fight against raid bosses.

Crusader
The damage the Crusader receives from his Triple Charging has been slightly reduced. In return, his basic skill has been accelerated and turned into an area attack that can hurt several enemies at once. Additionally, his healing and the ‘Growing Shield’ skill have been reworked.

Assassin
The Assassin can now deal critical damage to his opponents with his daggers for a longer period of time. In return, his burst damage has been slightly reduced.

Dragon Knight
The Dragon Knight now heals when enemies attack his ‘Draconium Shield’ skill.

Blaster
The buff duration of several skills has been slightly increased. In addition, his ‘Dragon’s Breath’ skill now triggers a buff for the player instead of debuffing the opponent.

Gravity
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been slightly improved.

Hydraulic Fist
The Hydraulic Fist now regains mana when enemies attack into his ‘Frontal Block’ skill.

Archmage
The Archmage now heals himself only half as much as his allies.

Scout 
The Scout now reduces less critical damage of incoming attacks.

Seer 
The cooldown of the ‘Mind Sink’ skill has been increased. Additionally, the damage reduction of his mana shield has been weakened.

Dark Gunner
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been significantly reduced.

Berserker: 
The ‘Break Armour’ skill now reduces the enemy’s defence level by 5 instead of 7 levels.


Improved Game Features

As already announced, this update also includes some more of the longed-for ‘Quality of Life’ improvements that should make your adventures in NosTale a little more enjoyable. The following improvements will be made to the game:


The Asgobas raid has been revised: the difficulty of the antechambers has been reduced and you now have to defeat significantly fewer monsters in the raid.
The Revenant Paimon raid has been revised: you can now no longer use mounts in the raid and some monsters can see invisible players. In return, you are now guaranteed an SP9 Perfection Stone after every raid.
Raid entries are now only consumed when the respective raid has been successfully completed.
Raid reward chests are now stacked in the inventory (instead of occupying one inventory slot per item). From them you get items with a random rare-level between R0 and R6. This does not affect particularly rare R7 and R8 chests: they remain as separate items.
The cost of scrolls and resistances from the Act 8 raid token shop has been reduced.
You can find the complete list of changes in the patch notes.

Have fun, 
The NosTale Team

notes.content:

We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to get hitched! You can look forward to romantic events and a brand new Battle Pass season with great rewards up for grabs, even if you don’t own the Premium expansion. Read on to find out everything you need to know!

Valentine’s Day in NosTale

From 13th February (11 AM) to 22nd February (9 AM CET), there are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you in NosTale:

Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows

Help Amora spread the love in NosVille. To do that she’ll need some arrows.
Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her!
You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.

Event: Show Your Feelings

Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.
Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love!
If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.
1–3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing
4–9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing
10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing
Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong!
Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.

Event: Amora’s Missing Wings
Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: Wingless Amora (one per character).

Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount. Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more. This offer will end once the Valentine’s event is over. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.

Benefit from the Battle Pass Now

In NosTale, a new season of our amazing Battle Pass awaits you. Enjoy many benefits and secure additional rewards as a Premium expansion owner! The current Battle Pass season runs from 14th February (midnight) to 14th March (midnight, CET).

This Is the NosTale Battle Pass
With NosTale’s Battle Pass, you complete daily, weekly and seasonal challenges that earn you Battle Points. You can collect rewards for the points you earn. And everyone can benefit: Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

By the way: all rewards can be collected until 28th March at midnight (CET). Plus
you still have a chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward, even if you miss the first week of the Battle Pass season.

Rewards: 

Protection Amulet
NosMerchant Medal (7 Days)
Equipment Protection Scroll
a new exclusive title
many more prizes

How About the Premium Expansion?
If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for you if you want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

The Premium Battle Pass of the current season costs 250 NosDollars. If you want to invest less time, get the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall. With this coin you can skip a step and directly get 50 Battle Points. The coin will be available in the NosMall from 27th February (11 AM CET).

Rewards:

Golden Equipment Protection Scroll
a new exclusive pet
many more prizes


Have fun!

notes.title: Community Update – First half of 2023
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello everyone! It’s time for another community update.

In 2022, we released lots of new content, including Act 8 and the new specialist cards. We also listened to your feedback and made some balancing adjustments and improved the playability of certain specialist cards. Of course, we also have a lot planned for you in 2023. In the following, we’ll give you a little preview of what’s to come in the next six months.

Kicking things off in January: the new version of the Time-Space events. We’ve adjusted the rewards for this and all future events (Lunar New Year Event, Valentine’s Day Event, Easter Event, etc.) and made sure that there are now more incentives to participate.

We also plan on continuing to improve playability, just as we have done regularly over the past few years. We’ve already made great progress in this area thanks to your great feedback. So look forward to more positive changes! And yes, that includes balance adjustments for Master Wolf, the Crusader and the Holy Mage. These changes are scheduled for the first quarter of 2023.

Speaking of specialist cards... Originally we had planned to release a new Lifestyle specialist card in the second half of 2022, but we had to postpone that in order to be able to put more time into the development of SP10. This project is now complete, so you can look forward to a new Lifestyle specialist who can tame and improve pets – to be released soon.

Of course, we also have to address the winners of our competition. We’re not talking about the story competition (as announced, there will be news about that in January), but about last year’s fan art contest. We have already implemented the Lunar Wings this year, but we would like to incorporate more of your ideas into the game.

Last but not least, we have good news for all players on the Cylloan server. As you may know, the main problem is the server location in the US, which is why we couldn’t act earlier. But don’t worry, no member of the NosTale family is left behind! In the coming months, we will conduct a migration test to move the server to Europe. If everything works out, we can hopefully carry out the merge you have been longing for. We don’t want to give you false hope – we can’t guarantee that this will work. But rest assured, we will do our best to find a satisfactory solution for everyone.

And that concludes our little preview. As you can see, we have a lot planned for the next six months, so we certainly won’t get bored. One more small spoiler: in the second half of the year we have a frosty surprise for you! But until then... you’ll have to wait and see. ;)

Have a great start to the New Year!
he NosTale Team
