notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg

As you know, winter can get cold and uncomfortable. But not in your favourite game! In NosTale, you can expect lots of exciting events that you can hugely benefit from. You can look forward to a number of events such as our Winter Raids, special quests, awesome gifts and much more:

Ends: 18th January at 9:00 AM (CET)

Winter Raids
Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Completion Gemstone Random Box.

Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

Specialist Partners
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger. With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power.

Holiday Offers in the NosMall
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – including a festive Miniland decoration! 

Wishing you a wonderful winter season!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: UPDATE: Four New Specialists
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a3b8b69794cedc0e51a1f5f732cd925f22382930.jpg

At the turn of the year, you can look forward to the biggest update in a long time: four brand new specialists are coming to NosTale – one for each class, as well as numerous quests and a thrilling raid! Read on to find out the most important details about the new content. First up, the new specialists:

The New Specialists
Become the greatest hero in NosTale with one of the four brand new specialists. But first you must free the souls of the contenders. To do this, you’ll complete an exciting series of quests in which you hunt monsters and collect Time-Space Stones and other items. Which of the four new specialists will you free?

DRAGON KNIGHT for Swordsmen
The Dragon Knight wields a mighty lance for which even dragon scales are no match. To go with it, he carries a shield that cannot be harmed by magic and can even withstand dragon’s breath. The Dragon Knight’s attacks fill up his ‘Polished Lance’ bar: the longer he brawls with his enemies, the stronger his attacks become. In addition, his skills enable him to pierce the armour of enemies, causing them to suffer great damage from his other skills.

BLASTER for Archers
The Blaster carries a devastating cannon which can launch various grenades and take down even the toughest enemies. The longer he fires his cannon, the hotter it gets. This in turn gives him powerful additional effects that he can use to inflict further damage on his opponent. But if the Blaster’s weapon overheats, he cannot use any skills for a short time until it has cooled down again. By reloading regularly he can prevent overheating and even increase his damage.

GRAVITY for Mages
Gravitas rules over gravity: with the help of his gravitational sphere, he manipulates gravity and antigravity to his advantage. Depending on which element he uses, the power of the respective element increases. When he has fully tamed the two forces of gravity and antigravity, he reaches gravitational equilibrium to unleash special bonus abilities for his skills.

HYDRAULIC FIST for Martial Artists
While the Hydraulic Fist may have a weak physique, he makes up for it with his devastating metallic fists. The Hydraulic Fist’s robotic arms are Draconium gauntlets powered by a magical engine that helps them unleash their immense destructive force. By supplying sufficient fuel, his attacks are significantly strengthened and receive additional bonus effects.

The New Raid
To upgrade your new specialist with Perfection Stones, you will face dangerous adversaries in a challenging boss room in the new raid. Prepare for battle! It definitely won’t be a piece of cake!

More New Content
In addition to the new content mentioned above, you can expect additional quests and our winter events with brilliant rewards and festive offers. Keep your eyes peeled for our next news post and find out what Christmas in NosTale has in store for you!

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/4e3e338234f76014cdfb8c5d077a13fe7d696169.jpg

Tiny spideys are creeping in, more and more of them.
‘Where could they all be coming from?’ you ask aghast.
You answer the door, and find a cheeky pumpkin grinning back.
What’s this gloomy mood that has overcome you?
You check your calendar and see the date.
It’s the end of October. Time to celebrate: Halloween!

Get ready: from 26th October to 9th November, NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

Event Raids
Jack O’Lantern and His Minions
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

Foxy and Her Brood
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

Mad Professor Macavity
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!

Full details on the raid:
Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.Players who want to play must bring a pet.Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
Daily Quests
The Cursed 13
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a new title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
NosMall Offers
Pick your favourite monstrous costume and give enemies a good scare: during the event period, the Plague Doctor/Nurse Costume will be available in the NosMall.

When you use an attack skill while wearing this eerie outfit, you have an 8% probability of receiving a 10-second healing effect which restores your HP by 5% of the damage dealt (maximum of 1,500 HP per skill). You also benefit from a 20% increase in champion experience and an additional +1 movement speed.

Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Contest: Your Chance to Write History!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9bf3d7e81291c1c0d73db080dfe7ba6ab1dda6d7.jpg

Can you believe it? It’s been fully 15 years since your favourite game was released, and in honour of this great milestone we’re of course pushing the boat out in NosTale, with plenty of celebrations and fresh content, including a new Battle Pass season and tons of events!

Speaking of fresh content, a while back we made a promise... of new specialist cards! That’s right, we haven’t forgotten. While we continue working on them, we want to celebrate the NosTale anniversary with an exciting contest. Read on to find out what’s in store for you!

Contest Idea
Have you always wanted to play your part in writing history? Then here’s your chance! Grab a quill and ink, get your creative juices flowing, and write us a short story of how you imagine the new specialists should be introduced in NosTale! You can find some more details about them below if you need some inspiration.

The best stories we receive will be used for writing the quests you’ll need to complete in order to acquire the new specialist cards!

How to Participate
Write a story featuring the four new specialists. Send your story to us at anniversaryevent@nostale.co.uk using the subject line ‘Anniversary Story Contest 2022’. Please use the same email address you are registered to the game with. Please include the name of your character, as well as the server on which you play.The deadline for submissions is 24/10/2022 at 9:00 CEST.Your story must be written in English. If you can’t write fluently in English, then write your story in your native language, and then use the internet tool DeepL to translate it into English.
What Can I Win?
The 10 best stories will be rewarded with the following prizes:

1st to 3rd place
Title “Wordsmith”Baby PandaRetro wings in colour of choice
4th to 5th place
Title “Wordsmith”Crystal Wings
6th to 10th place
Title “Wordsmith”Onyx Wings
The rest of the participants will get 2 Event Box.

The NosTale team will vote to select the best submissions after the deadline has passed, and roughly two weeks later we will announce the winners. Afterwards, the prizes will be sent out, and we’ll share the best stories with you.

The New Specialists
The Swordsman specialist is a valiant warrior, adept at combat with a huge lance. To prove his skills, he once thrust his lance into a rock, leaving a gaping hole, and said ‘I shall leave a mark like that in Asgobas’ heart!’

The Archer specialist lost his parents long ago and swore revenge. His body has been steeled by having to carry a powerful weapon which fires explosive cannonballs. 

The Mage specialist harnesses the energy of dragons to manipulate gravity with psychokinesis. ‘I will use gravity to correct my mistakes!’

The Martial Artist specialist was a brilliant scientist, who was always troubled with a weakly constitution. At least, he was until he created his deadly machine: ‘I’m happy I can use my knowledge to save lives.’

Note: this contest is subject to our Terms and Conditions for Participation in Raffles and Competitions.

Best of luck!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some language servers together in August (final date will be announced very soon).

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

We are merging the following servers together:
DE 1 (Ancelloan) + DE 2 (Fortuna) = DE 1 (Alzanor)EN 3 (International-1) + EN 4 (International-2) = EN 3 (INT-Valehir)
As you can see, we're merging some English servers, as well as the German servers. No changes will be made to any other servers.

Server Merge FAQ

How did you decide which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

Are the US servers not being merged?
The US servers will be merged at a later date. We’re going to have a test phase this summer, during which we will request your feedback so we can proceed with the US server merge soon.

What languages can I use on the Europe server, and what language will Support use?
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire Europe server. And Support will still be available to help you in the languages you are used to. The only change is that from now on you’ll be on a server with lots of other languages being spoken at once.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):
Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial ArtistsThree slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial ArtistsAll four slots will be occupied by your characters. Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial ArtistsIf you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThree slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThe slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. You can change your active characters on the website at any time.
What’s happening to families?
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What’s happening to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What if two or more characters have the same name?
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update - Summer 2022
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

Time really flies when you’re having fun! With half of the year already behind us, it’s about time we had another round of ‘What’s going down in the world of NosTale over the coming months?’

But before we get down to it, just the usual quick note that the following are only plans that may be subject to change. It’s entirely possible that some things get pulled forward, while others end up on the back-burner, so please see this roadmap as a general guide of what lies ahead, rather than a set of commandments chiselled in stone.

With that out of the way, let’s get to it!

In general, balancing changes and quality of life improvements will continue to be released sporadically between larger updates. There’s more than enough work to be done here, and while we don’t want to nail ourselves to any specific changes, rest assured we won’t be running out things to improve any time soon.

We previously announced the next round of balancing changes which will concentrate on the Master Wolf, Holy Mage and Crusader specialists. A little further on the horizon will be the Warrior, Sunchaser and Mystic Arts.

If you’re one of those people who’d much rather decimate the local wildlife though, don’t worry, we’ve got you covered, with SP10 planned for the end of the year! That’s right, we’re looking to introduce a new specialist for every class. Such big content changes always require a lot of effort, so we can’t absolutely guarantee that this patch won’t be pushed back to the following year, but for now we’re definitely aiming at a 2022 release.

Even though we already had a round of server merges in the first half of the year, we’re planning more for the second half. This time will focus on those servers which didn’t need any change in the last round, but where activity has dropped off and the requests for a merge have become louder.
Please note that we’ll only go into more specific detail (regarding which servers and when etc.) at a later point in time. Because of its geographic location, merging the US server (EN2) is giving us some headaches which will need more time to iron out, so it’s possible that this server will not be part of the second round of merges.

As it’s been almost a year since the last new server launch, we’ll probably have some news on that front in the second half of the year, but again, more details will follow in due course.

As ever, there’ll be seasonal events to look forward to, and doubtless a few new items will find their way into the game. And let’s not forget that NosTale will pass a huge milestone and celebrate its 15th anniversary in October! That’s right, if we’re made to feel old, you have to share our pain!

And that about wraps up everything we have to tell! As already mentioned at the start, it’s entirely possible for some of these plans to get waylaid or for others to take their place.  But we hope this update at least gives you a flavour of the things to come.

Wishing you a (not too) warm and sunny summer!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update: Specialist Partner Fusion & Wing Fusion
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cbee6baf64337366ecc706fd0b0517bc35449a00.jpg

Not long now until 6th July, when you can start to explore the changes we wrote about in our last post: Specialist Partner Fusion and Wing Fusion!

Specialist Partner Fusion is a new system which enables you to use the specialist partner cards you don’t need to upgrade the ones you do. Fusing them together gives your partners powerful bonuses!

Meanwhile, in the NosMall you can find the Wing Changer (Random), which gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of certain wings onto another pair. Keep the cool effects of the wings you have, while enjoying the looks of the wings which best suit your hero!

Trailer
Check out the trailer for the update here:

[previewyoutube=1yiQZ3GnYMk;full][/previewyoutube]

Patch Notes
Added the specialist partner fusion system.
Specialist partner fusion allows you to upgrade your specialist partner cards by fusing unused cards with your main one. As with the familiar perfecting system you know from regular specialist cards, this permanently increases their stats.You can upgrade you specialist partners with every alchemist in the big towns.If you fuse your specialist partner card with an identical one, you’ll receive double the experience.An identical specialist partner card is even a requirement for upgrading from levels 19, 39, 59, 79 and 99. Exceeding these levels gives you a large amount of additional skill points.Temporary specialist partner cards and specialist partners with similar appearances (such as Foxy and Fiona) are considered copies for the purposes of the specialist partner fusion.When you upgrade your specialist partner card, it will randomly increase one of the following 8 stats: attack, defence, crit damage reduction, HP/MP, fire resistance, water resistance, light resistance or shadow resistance.The number of points depends on the card’s current upgrade level. In total you can receive up to 390 skill points, shared across all 8 stats, but you can never have more than 100 points in one main stat, or 35 points in a resistance stat.
Added a wing randomiser item.
This was suggested by the players and was originally intended to be implemented as a wing fusion system. However, having thought more about the issue, we decided that few players would want to ‘waste’ an expensive pair of wings for the sake of a new appearance. So we’ve implemented this as a system which allows you to try out lots of different wing designs in the game, irrespective of their effects!An option has been added to the specialist card interface which allows you to remove the current wing design.All buffs granted by specialist wings have their own buff symbol, making it easier to identify which wing effects are active.When using this item, you can't get the same wings twice in a row. You also won't receive the appearance of your currently equipped wings.
Added a Retro Wing randomiser item to the Rainbow Crystal shop.
We also wanted to give you the option to try out the newly introduced Retro Wings in a separate package. Given the different colour variations, there was no easy way to include them in the regular wing fusion, without drowning out the other wing options. Please note that this item can only be used by characters who are already wearing Retro Wings.
Improvements to the fishing system.
We understand that many of you find the current fishing system rather monotonous and not worthy of your time. We believe that the main reason for this is the very low chance of catching legendary fish. So we’ve decided to greatly increase (quadruple!) the chance of landing one, thereby also increasing the speed of levelling up (as legendary fish provide more fishing XP than regular ones).In this update we’re also introducing items which support your fishing activities.One additional change we’re implementing will however reduce the sale price of legendary fish. When we originally introduced the fishing system, legendary fish could be sold for high prices, as they had no other use. But since the introduction of the cooking system, they can now be used as ingredients for meals. The high price of the fish has led to cooking being far more expensive than originally planned. Of course, there are also expensive meals which are not fish-based, and we plan to take a look at these in due course. But with the increased fishing chances, we’re confident about making this change. We think that players will still be able to trade these fish amongst themselves for a decent price, but selling them to NPCs will no longer be as lucrative.We’ve slightly increased the success rate when fishing, and greatly reduced the chance of your line tearing.Most fishing titles have been improved and now give you more fishing XP and improved fishing chances.You can now only buy up to 250 fishing baits per day.
Changes to the minigame raids.
Two of the main issues with the minigame raids were that they were hardly worth playing and that they always started at random times. We’ve made some changes to hopefully improve both of these points, but we’ll be keeping our eyes on them in future, so please send us your feedback or suggestions if you have any!The raid seals for the Sheep Farm, Dodge Meteor and Bushi King Defence have been removed from the game.These three raids now start automatically at fixed times on channels 1 and 2 (CET/CEST):Sheep Farm: 1:15, 4:15, 7:15, 10:15, 13:15, 16:15, 19:15, 22:15Dodge Meteor: 2:15, 5:15, 8:15, 11:15, 14:15, 17:15, 20:15, 23:15Bushi King Defence: 0:15, 3:15, 6:15, 9:15, 12:15, 15:15, 18:15, 21:15You can now purchase a Specialist Partner Box containing 1 of 9 specialist partner cards for 1 Golden Acorn and 1 Silver Acorn.The number of Acorns required to craft a Bronze Acorn has been reduced from 50 to 15.The Acorn rewards for the individual raids has been improved:Sheep Farm: In addition to the raid box you now get some Acorns depending on your ranking:1st Place: 15 Acorns2nd–3rd Place: 10 Acorns4th–10th Place: 7 Acorns11th–20th Place: 5 Acorns21st–30th Place: 3 AcornsDodge Meteor: The amount of Acorns dropped between each phase has been increased as follows:After round 1: 10 Acorns -> 15 AcornsAfter round 2: 10 Acorns -> 20 AcornsAfter round 3: 10 Acorns -> 25 AcornsAfter round 4: 10 Acorns -> 30 AcornsIf you die during round 1, you’ll now get 1 Acorns instead of 0.If you die after completing round 1, you’ll now get 3 Acorns instead of 1.If you die after completing round 2, you'll now get 6 Acorns instead of 2.If you die after completing round 3, you'll now get 10 Acorns instead of 3.The rewards for rounds 4 and 5 remain unchanged (1 or 2 Bronze Acorns respectively).Bushi King Defence: In addition to the raid boxes (2 for the winners, 1 for the losers), the following changes have been implemented:The winning team now additionally receives 10 Acorns.The losing team now additionally receives 5 Acorns.The Bushi King Defence raid can now be started with a minimum of 10 instead of 20 players.The contents of the Bushi King Gift Box have been changed to provide more consistent Acorn rewards.Please note that you still need to meet the activity point requirement to receive a reward.
Other changes:
You can now transform champion level equipment into partner equipment. Partners can only wear this gear if their master also has the appropriate champion level.All cooldowns are reset after completing a Celestial Spire level.All cooldowns are reset after completing a round of the Arena of Talents.The debuff which you get when three characters with the same class start the Arena of Talents is now a neutral debuff (so you can change your specialist card).Dragon Gems, Shining Green Souls and Shining Red Souls have been added as map drops in the lower Land of Life (C30-C59).Shining Red Souls and Shining Blue Souls have been added as map drops in the upper Land of Life (C60-C80).Added new icons to the Erenia, Zenas and Fernon fairies, matching their respective elements.Rune powers now also work on secondary weapons.The knockback effect of the Kickback Power rune power now only applies to enemies in PvP.Dowsing Rods now show the location of hidden spaces across the entire map.You can now exchange 25x Draco’s Claw/Glacerus’ Mane for 5x Ruby/Sapphire of Completion from Sarakael.Eva Energy now sells animal food which increases your NosMate’s loyalty to 1,000.Upgraded NosMate Guardian Angels and Partner’s Guardian Angels which resurrect your pets/partners with 100% of their HP/MP are now available from Malcolm Mix. They are consumed before the regular guardian angels.The Guardian Angel’s Blessing now increases the experience of your NosMates and partners by 100% (previously it only applied to NosMates and increased the experience by 50%).When you right-click on an equipped fairy, you can now see how many monsters you still need to kill before it upgrades to the next level.Skill cooldowns are now displayed in minutes and seconds in the skill bar.The buff bar has been expanded from 2 to 3 rows, allowing you to see up to 30 buffs at once.If you click on a friend/foe, you can now see 15 effects instead of 8. These are also divided into a row of buffs and a row of debuffs.When clicking on a target, you can now see their exact current/max HP/MP values.The set effect of the Ice Witch costume has been changed: When attacked, you now have a 10% chance to heal for 3% of your max. HP. The set effect now also already activates when wearing the costume and wings (instead of the full set).
Bug fixes:
Partners can now use the orange-coloured effects from their partner equipment correctly.Fixed an error which caused specialist partners to show an upgrade level when wearing certain gear long before this update.Fixed an error in which players received an incorrect error message when trying to equip a specialist partner card on a partner below level 30.Fixed an error which prevented players listing multiple items with a total sales fee of more than 100,000 Gold without an active NosMerchant Medal.Fixed an error which caused characters to lose gold if they tried to use the ‘Close All’ function when having multiple items at the bazaar, whilst being too close to the gold cap, causing it to be exceeded.Fixed an error which caused the page to jump back to page 1 when editing the sales price of an item on page 4 or higher in the bazaar.Added the missing Produce (Loop) button for the following items: Half Moon Crystal, Full Moon Crystal, Red Crystal Piece, Blue Crystal Piece, White Crystal Piece, Black Crystal PieceThe debuff resistance on the Blue Magician’s Frozen Shield is now instantaneous and not just a side-effect after 0.1 seconds.Fixed an error which allowed players to use some of the Avenging Angel’s skills in unexpected ways.Fixed a bug that caused players to not receive any rewards from the Caligor raid if he was killed by an Onyx shadow.Fixed a bug that caused the damage from Erenia's Deadly Blackout attack to only occur on the next attack.Any buffs received from a mount are now properly removed when entering Erenia/Zenas raidsThe Flame Druid can now also activate partner skills while in his human stance.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update Ready to Launch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cbee6baf64337366ecc706fd0b0517bc35449a00.jpg

The next update is bringing two great changes to your favourite game: Specialist Partner Fusion and Wing Fusion!

Learn more details about what to expect below.

Specialist Partner Fusion
To make sure your partners stay the distance and don’t wilt at the first sign of danger, we’re introducing a new system to the game in the form of the Specialist Partner Fusion. This allows you to make use of those specialist partner cards you don’t need, whilst simultaneously strengthening your favourites!

Simply open the Specialist Partner Fusion menu, and drag in the partner card you want to improve and the one you want to use as a material. The only other thing required is a bit of gold, and some additional materials, depending on the current level of your card.

The fusion works best if you use the same cards, but other partner cards can be used to give your favourites a boost up to a certain level. Certain levels will however require that you use the same card for upgrading. The maximum level you can reach through Specialist Partner Fusion is level 100.

Fusing cards gives your specialists more HP, better defence, reduced damage from crits, and other powerful bonuses, depending on the level and experience of the specialist partner card you use as the material.

Wing Fusion
Similar to the system for Mysterious Hair Dye, in the future you’ll find a new item in the NosMall – the Wing Changer (Random)! This gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of your wings to another pair, allowing you to benefit from the powerful effects of one set of wings, while enjoying the appearance of a different set you prefer.

There’s a button on your specialist card allowing you to reset the original appearance for free, in case you ever have second thoughts about your choice. Please note that the wings newly added to the game will not be available for Wing Fusion.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2b21b11fcd9056f075b5ddb4f2f279d08923310e.jpg

Adventurers, travellers, heroes! Troubling news has reached us from NosVille that hordes of wild monsters are streaming across the lands. We don’t know the reason for their appearance, but everything is going to rack and ruin for the poor innocent inhabitants. 

Join forces and send these monsters back whence they came. The more maps that you liberate of monsters, the better your rewards will be. May peace return to NosVille!

Event period: From 14th June (11 AM) to 22nd June (9 AM CEST)

Liberate Maps of Monsters
A portal will open in NosVille (channel 7) leading you to five different maps absolutely swarming with monsters! 

If you’re playing on a less highly populated server, you won’t face quite so many, but on fuller servers, you’ll have even more enemies to deal with!

The more players who successfully participate, the greater the rewards for your server at the end!

Reward Event
The reward event for your hard work will be active between 24th June (11 AM) and 27th June (11 AM CEST). It’s down to you how juicy it will be:

Higher Chances of Raid Boxes 

Why open one raid box when you can open two? The chance of receiving two raid boxes is increased by 50% for all players on your server.

And for each region you’ve rid of monsters, we’ll add an extra 10% on top of that 50% boost!  However you’ll also lose 5% for every map you didn’t liberate.

Example 1: If you liberate two maps on your server, you’ll enjoy a boost of 55% → basic boost of 50% + 2 x 10% for maps liberated - 3 x 5% for maps not liberated = 55%

Example 2: If you don’t liberate any maps on your server, you’ll still enjoy a boost of 25% → basic boost of 50% + 0 x 10% for maps liberated - 5 x 5% for maps not liberated = 25%

Best of luck!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Celestial Lair: Part 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/77909655889035b8314d941de97d98bae0c6361b.jpg

At the end of last year, a new adventure got underway in NosTale with the release of Act 8 – The Celestial Lair. In Part 2, we’re bringing a host of cool twists and improvements to bring more variety to your favourite game. Get the lowdown on all the changes in this post!

Land of Life
In a similar vein to the Land of Death, you can level up your hero on this map by battling against golden yet dangerous monsters with your NosTale family. Uncover hidden altars and enjoy various bonuses!

You can access the Land of Life from the capital in Act 8. The map is available around the clock, and you have around 2 hours per day for hunting monsters there.

Armour Runes
You can now add runes to your champion level armour! These runes give you a small armour bonus (+1 to +21). The runes are similar to the ones you know from weapons: attempting to carve runes can be successful, fail, or the rune can be damaged. In contrast to weapon runes, you can only apply 3 different rune effects to your armour.

Amongst other things, you require Runic Dragon Powder for carving runes, which can be collected in all Act 8 regions, and of course in the Land of Life.

More Fun!
Thanks to our latest balancing changes, you have even more reason to upgrade your weapons. You can focus on attack strength when upgrading your weapons, and defence when upgrading your armour.

Tattoos have also been overhauled, giving you all the more reason to experiment with their various effects and buffs.

NosMall Offers
Four amazing items are also waiting for you in the NosMall:

Cellon Eraser
Reset your accessories. This eraser removes all Cellon options from an accessory, giving you space for new ones!
Tattoo Switch Scroll (Random)
Try something new. This scroll gives you a new tattoo skill from your loa. If you change tattoos, the level of your previous one will be transferred to the new one.
Loa Switch Crystal
Explore new possibilities. Change your tattoo loa and then get a random tattoo from the chosen loa with the same level as your previous tattoo.
Premium Runic Upgrade Scroll
Even easier rune carving. This scroll not only increases your chances of success by a whopping 30%, but also increases the chance of getting a rune power by 5%. Your weapon will not be damaged when carving, and you have a 50% chance that the material used is not consumed. As if that weren’t enough, you even save half of the gold costs with every attempt!

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some language servers together.

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

We’ve merged the following servers together:
EN1 UK–NosCitadel + ES1 Infinity + PL1 Feniks + IT1 Flare = EU-DragonveilFR1 Cosmos + FR2 Galaxie = Cosmos
No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

Server Merge FAQ

How did you decide which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and balanced activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What languages can I use on the Dragonveil server, and what language will Support use?
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire Dragonveil server. And Support will still be available to help you in the languages you are used to. The only change is that from now on you’ll be on a server with lots of other languages being spoken at once.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):
Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters.Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

What’s happening to families?
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What’s happening to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What if two or more characters have the same name?
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team  to change the family name manually.

What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our Support team.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friend lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Will my login details get changed by the merge?
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team  will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update 1/22
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

As some of you may have noticed... it’s the start of a new year! And of course that means it’s time for another community update.

As the last update was around half a year ago now, here is a short explanation of what community updates are. For a while now, at the start and middle of the year, we send out a little note summarising any updates, changes, and ideas we’re considering for the months thereafter. 

Of course, nothing is set in stone, and sometimes plans are pushed back or forward. But this just gives you a good overview of what you can look forward to. The plans discussed in today’s update will cover the first half of 2022 (in no particular order). We’re looking forward to another wonderful year with you all!

Of course, the biggest point on the list is the second half of the Act 8 Update. As the main feature of 8.2., our plan is to introduce a champion level equivalent to the Land of Death, something that’s been requested for a while now. We also want to make some significant changes to runes and tattoos. As well as introducing new stuff (why exactly do runes only work on weapons?), we will also have to take a piercing gaze at a few things needing nerfs.

Another greatly awaited topic that we will be turning our minds to now the new year has started is merging more servers. The whos, whats and wherefores regarding this merge will all be made clear in separate news posts. For the moment, we just want you to know that we see and hear the calls for merges loud and clear, and are making preparations.

But servers aren’t the only things that will see some merging in the next 6 months! We’re currently in discussions with Entwell about a possible merge system for partners and wings: two areas that we know are very much hoped for by the community.

And of course we have to mention the hotly discussed balance patches, as they are absolutely still on the cards. The next pair we have planned are for Seers and Berserkers. We’re diligently pottering about making plenty of improvements.

Besides all of that, you can also look forward to another season of the battle pass, as well as all the usual seasonal events, and some fantastic new items (such as a pair of wings based on the winner of our last fan art competition).

As you can see, we’ve got plenty of things in the works. Let us know what you think of our ideas! We love to hear your opinions. You’ll be hearing from us in at most 6 months with another community update for you.

Wishing you the best possible start to your new year,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter Events in NosTale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale: This Christmas will be a scream, with plenty of awesome events, amazing loot, great offers, and seasonal surprises!

There’s plenty to look forward to between 13/12/2021 and 12/1/2022:

Holiday Offers in the NosMall
This year there are plenty of wintery items waiting for you in the NosMall – open the doors in our advent calendar and find out what’s inside!

During the holidays the Jewel Shop is closed. But don’t worry, from 15th to 29th December 2021, the NosTale Christmas Market will be open and you can get all sorts of things there, like Christmas costumes and pretty decorations for your Miniland.

Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer

The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

Specialist Partners

Use Maru’s Specialist Partner Card to transform partners that use melee attacks into the Millennial Tiger. Use the second Specialist Partner Card, Maru in Mother’s Fur, to transform partners that use melee attacks into a tiger disguised as a caring mother of siblings. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power

Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Obsidian of Completion.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

Snowman Raid

Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! You’ll get a raid box as a reward. You’ll find awesome specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items inside.

Daily Quests

You’ll be able to play the following dailies during the event:
Searching for the Siblings’ MotherSave the SiblingsNeed Sesame Oil
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as a reward when you complete these daily quests.

Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille

You’ll meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Complete quests to collect colourful stockings and then exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

Event Quest

Pay a visit to the Wanderer to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and grab yourself some great items.

Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil

Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters. Exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore your and your NosMate’s HP and MP, and the Sesame Oil is useful in raids.

Happy New Year… Literally!

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful Winter Event!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 8 – The Celestial Lair
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9da43444f9773e07d90b56398fb7ad30f0cb4b12.jpg

The time has come – a new adventure has begun! Act 8 – The Celestial Lair breathes new life into NosTale. Get ready for extra maps, raids, time-spaces, new equipment, an expanded specialist system and much more! And of course you’ll also find out what happens next in the NosTale story.

The Story

The story continues as you meet Ain, the ingenious inventor. Her people live on a floating archipelago that has recently come under attack. To rescue them, you must take on the Dragov – a group of radical Draconians who worship dragons as if they were gods. You will encounter ruthless opponents like zombie dragon Valehir, ice dragon Alzanor and their leader, Dragon Lord Asgobas!

Play through new quests – including 8 new time-spaces, multiple dungeons and a host of side stories and daily quests.

Two New Raids

Both new raids feature two lobby maps where you’ll complete various tasks. A new token system also provides you with rare raid rewards which you can trade.

Asgobas’ Invasion

In these action-packed instant combats, you must defend the floating islands against the marauding dragons. You will be richly rewarded if you return from these battles as the conquering hero!

Specialist System Expanded

Upgrade your specialist to level 20 with immediate effect to earn a shot at unlocking a special attack with extra effects. You can also increase their specialist points to a maximum of 120, depending on the level. This update also boosts the chances of reaching level 15, so specialist novices can enjoy the benefits of the system expansion too!

New Equipment

There’s a fine line between winning and losing, and having the right equipment makes all the difference. In Act 8 you can pick up some new equipment to propel you to your chosen champion level. You can also get your hands on some powerful equipment if you are already playing the endgame. Take the opportunity to grab some new accessories, hats, and resistances that you can rely on as you fight your way through NosTale’s raids!

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Ghoulishly Grandiose Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/427337f349d886aa68fe57c05a71ba4afeca4ed4.jpg

Tiny spideys are creeping in, more and more of them.
‘Where could they all be coming from?’ you ask aghast.
You answer the door, and find a cheeky pumpkin grinning back.
What’s this gloomy mood that has overcome you?
You check your calendar and see the date.
It’s the end of October. Time to celebrate: Halloween!

Get ready: from 27/10 to 10/11 NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

Your new creepy costume
Give friends and enemies a good scare: during the event period, the Plague Doctor/Nurse Costume will be available in the NosMall.

When you use an attack skill while wearing this eerie outfit, you have an 8% probability of receiving a 10-second healing effect which restores your HP by 5% of the damage dealt (maximum of 1,500 HP per skill). You also benefit from a 20% increase in champion experience and an additional +1 movement speed.

The Cursed 13
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a new title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering ‘Horror’ when you attack.

Titles with powerful effects
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
Test Subject: Increases resistance to Bleeding by 1%.Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
Mad Professor Macavity
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!
Full details on the raid:
Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.Players who want to play must bring a pet.Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
Foxy and Her Brood
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

Jack O’Lantern and His Minions
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

Daily quests from NosVille NPCs
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Anniversary Fan Art Contest 2021
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9a96a4f0bcc43738c470b6c33beee13a74bdbf8b.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

In celebration of NosTale’s 14th anniversary, we’re running an international fan art contest in which players from around the world can compete to win some really cool in-game items.

But that’s not all! The theme for this competition is ‘Items and Equipment’, by which we mean armour, weapons, pets, partners, wings and costumes. The winning designs will be passed on to the game’s developers Entwell, and if they find a concept they like, they may even implement it in the game!

How to Participate
Submit your competition entry by 27th October via email to anniversaryevent@nostale.co.ukUse the subject line ‘Anniversary Fan Art Contest 2021’In addition to your design (max. 20MB), please include in the email your character name and the server which you play on (so we can send you your prizes if you win).
Prizes
The following prizes are up for grabs for the top 5 entries:
Crystal Wings (Limited)New Baby Raptor Pet (Limited)The ‘Artiste’ titleIf your entry is implemented in the game, you’ll get 5 copies of the item for you and your friends.
The entries ranked 6–20 will also receive the ‘Artiste’ title and a coupon worth €3.

All submissions will be reviewed from 27th October and the winners chosen from an internal vote open to all NosTale team members. After the voting is closed (~2 weeks), the winners will be officially announced and receive their rewards, with their submissions posted in our forums and on social media.

Please note: Winning does not guarantee that your idea will be implemented in the game; the final decision is down to game developers Entwell Co., Ltd. in South Korea.

Our Terms & Conditions for Raffles and Contests apply.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your pens and pencils and let’s go!

Bets of luck!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: International Server Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/71092fd237b9809edd4293faabbeb23e95b6ddc4.jpg

The wait is nearly over: the new international server INT2 launches on 27th August! Look forward to exciting challenges to master every week – the Raid Challenges!

Plus enjoy powerful boosts during the first month, and chat to your friends in your own language on the server.
The Raid Challenges
Play on the new international server and earn a new currency for completing Raid Challenges. The currency – NosJewels – can only be spent on this server. In the NosMall you’ll find a new category where you can spend your NosJewels on great rewards such as powerful wings, titles, potions and more!

You’ll find portals to the various event raids in the special event version of Port Alveus. Each entry costs a raid seal which you can pick up from the NosMall for free. One particular raid will be chosen each week for which you can earn points every day.

Points are awarded as follows:
Your team completes the raid fastest -> 20 pointsComplete the raid 10 times -> 10 pointsComplete the raid within a certain time -> 10 pointsReach the top 10 -> 20 points (for the top 10 players who complete the most raids on a particular day)Your account will be credited with NosJewels based on your daily rank, and you can then spend these on rewards. NosJewels are awarded every day at midnight. You can also view your ranking on the following website: https://en.nostale.gameforge.com/main/highscoreDates for the first challenges: Maru the Millennial Tiger – 27th August to 5th September Mad March Hare – 12th September to 19th SeptemberPlease note that the Raid Challenges are planned until mid-November. Future raids will be announced at a later date.Further Benefits
Start your new adventure and enjoy the following benefits during the first month:
Double EXPDouble Family EXPDouble Drop RateDouble Gold Drop
In addition the following boost remains available until level 85, irrespective of the EXP event:
Tart Hapendam’s Martial ArtsServer Language
The new international server won’t have any language region restrictions, providing 7 different channels. That means you can make an exciting new start, and experience everything in your own language, thanks to the multi-language client.

notes.title: New International Server
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/71092fd237b9809edd4293faabbeb23e95b6ddc4.jpg

Dear player,

We hope you’re ready for a new place to run around in and even more action: NosTale will have a new international server soon!

But it’s not just a new server. Oh no – it will have exciting event raid challenges that will be worth your while to master. More details will be provided before the server start!

The new international server won’t have any language region restrictions. That means you can make an exciting new start, and experience everything in your own language, thanks to the multi-language client.

In case you haven’t heard about our multi-language client yet, here are some FAQs that will explain everything you need to know:

International Server FAQ
What language will the new server support?
Everyone playing on the international server will have the ability to play in their own language. Players who aren’t interested in seeing a mix of languages will still be able to play on their regional non-multilingual servers. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on things, and may choose to establish a chat language at a later date.

What language will ticket support be in?
The international server’s ticket support will only be available in English.

Where can I go to discuss server-related things?
We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord. And, if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

Are you planning anything special for the server launch?
As mentioned above, we’re planning to have event raid challenges on the new international server. In addition, the server will receive several boost events for one month. We’ll release more details on challenges and boosts over the next few days.

notes.title: Four Brand New Specialists
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7278e4965e775e2cb26fc5a5f2748e3ed0dfbde6.jpg

Our newest update is coming – and with it comes a whole host of exciting content. Look forward to four brand new specialist cards, a thrilling quest series and a challenging raid! Read on to find out everything you need to know.
Spirit Forest Raid
Rally your fellow fighters and head to the Spirit Forest to talk to Datitus in order to start this new daily raid quest. 

A barrage of nasty monsters will be waiting in the wings to trip up you and your friends in each of the three raid areas, and you’ll find the boss Revenant Paimon waiting for you at the end. Be warned: He has three shadow clones of the new specialists at his side. Defeat them to win their support for your battle against Paimon!

The raid is open for up to 15 players (champion levels 10–60) and there are, of course, lots of valuable rewards up for grabs in addition to a punishing challenge.
The Ancient Orc Heroes
Use the Time-Space Stone to travel back into the past and discover how the Ancient Orc Heroes managed to put a stop to the demon Paimon. Learn more about the backgrounds of the new specialists along the way, and discover their secret.
New Specialist Cards
Fight as a Flame Druid with the power of the fire element, a Waterfall Berserker with a terrifying axe, a Sunchaser side by side with your Sun Wolf, or as a Voodoo Priest to inflict debilitating curses on your enemies.
The Flame Druid
‘With the power of the Bear Loa, I will incinerate evil!’

The new Flame Druid specialist card turns a Martial Artist into a powerful fire element druid who can transform into a bear or leopard. As a bear, the Flame Druid has bear-strength skills at their disposal; as a leopard, they won’t be able to attack but will move with the speed of a big wild cat!
Flame Druid Skill Highlights
Purifying Flames: The purifying flames burn away all your debuffs and make you highly resistant to enemy debuffs.
Removes all debuffs up to level 4.You’ll have a chance of resisting debuffs for a certain amount of time, based on the number of buffs you have (up to 30%).
Absorbing Flames: A hot flame burns away all attacks.
Doesn’t consume HP.It provides a 50% chance of triggering Fatal Burn.
Emberpunch: You deal a hefty uppercut with the flame energy crackling in your front legs.
There is a 100% chance of triggering Third-Degree Burns. The skill cooldown time is increased by 50%.It provides a 100% chance of triggering Blackout.
The Waterfall Berserker
‘Not even the coldest waterfall can cool my temper!’

The Waterfall Berserker specialist card turns a Swordsman into a hardened warrior of the water element, wielding a fearsome axe and unleashing unlimited fury in battle. The Waterfall Berserker is not someone you’d want to have as an enemy, that’s for sure!
Waterfall Berserker Skill Highlights
Clear Water: Heals you based on how much HP you’ve lost, and simultaneously increases your defence and elemental stats.
Restores 20% of lost HP.Increases your defence by 15%.Increases water element equivalent to the player’s level x4.
Under the Waterfall: The energy of the waterfall renders you immune to damage, and protects you from debuffs when enemies try to inflict damage on you.
Doesn’t consume HP.Removes 1 debuff (up to level 4) each time you’re hit.Provides a 40% chance of inflicting Serious Injury on an opponent. There’s a certain chance of the attacker’s skill cooldown time being reset when they attack.
Raging Waterfall: You jump into the air and beat your axes into the ground, inflicting damage to enemies over a large radius.
Reduces your opponent’s movement speed by 3.Increases the damage of all water element attacks by 20%.After the buff wears off, there’s a 100% chance of causing Serious Injury.
The Sunchaser
‘No one can hide from the sun!’

The Sunchaser specialist card enables Archers to assert themselves as hunters of the light element, who are always accompanied by a wolf. The Sun Wolf takes on its master’s level, has 5 of its own skills and can be revived. Your opponents had better not let themselves be dazzled by their refined appearance. Sunchasers fights with lethal precision!
Sunchaser Skill Highlights
Solar Shower: Numerous blazing spears fall from the sky and attack your opponent.
Provides a 20% chance of triggering Blinding Light: Reduces evasion by 50%.Reveals vulnerabilities when the Sun Wolf attacks. Increases long-range damage and critical hit rate by 10%.
Solar Eruption: Teleports your glowing Sun Wolf to the target, where it attacks and blinds them.
Teleports to the target at a range of 9 spaces.Pounces on opponents and causes AoE damage.It provides an 80% chance of triggering Blackout.
Light Net: When thrown, the spear turns into a light net which traps your enemy.
Renders enemies unable to move.When the Sun Wolf attacks, your damage increases by 50%.
The Voodoo Priest 
‘When you die, your soul belongs to me!’

With the new Voodoo Priest specialist card, Mages become shadow element priests who use curses to drive pain and fear into their enemies’ midst. Voodoo Priests can inflict several powerful debuffs onto multiple enemies simultaneously, and they have absolutely no reservations about putting these devastating curses to use! 
Voodoo Priest Skill Highlights
Soulwalk: You transform into a soul for a short time, becoming immune to damage and nullifying debuffs.
Removes all debuffs up to buff level 4Restores HP equivalent to the player’s level x10 every 2 seconds.Cannot attack.Doesn’t consume HP.You become invisible.
Locust Swarm: You summon a swarm of greedy locusts who inflict damage on opponents across a large area while you regenerate HP.
Restores HP equivalent to the player’s level x15.It provides a 25% chance of triggering Voodoo Priest Curse: Increases the efficiency of buffs which degrade HP and inflict damage over time by 15% per debuff.
Deathly Curse: You absorb your target’s soul energy and increase your power.
Only causes damage if the enemy is suffering from at least one debuff.The damage increases proportional to the number of debuffs active on your enemies.There is a 100% chance that the buff of the same name (Deathly Curse) will be triggered:You lose HP equivalent to the player’s level x6 every 2 seconds.Increases the damage of all shadow element attacks by 20%.


Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

The renowned scientist Dr Funkenstein has been beavering away in his laboratory, experimenting on ways to make pets even stronger. But he’s taken a dangerous path, using controversial techniques to splice their DNA together with strands from some of the more powerful monsters out there! He was on the cusp of making a major breakthrough, when something terrible happened… a loud bang, a fizz of sparks, and his entire experiment went up in smoke! Don’t worry, Dr Funkenstein is unharmed, but now all of his test subjects are running wild. That’s right, genetically modified monsters which could attack at any moment!

Find the right map where the monsters are lurking.

The monsters drop special loot you can take to Dr Funkenstein for valuable rewards.

Team up with other adventurers to hunt the monsters down more effectively.

notes.title: Community Update - Summer 2021
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

The second quarter of the year will end soon, and so it’s time for another community update.

In the last months, we were able to complete a number of our long-awaited projects and successfully merged databases and servers on an international level for the first time as well as launching new ones (any rumours about a 30-hour maintenance are wholly unfounded).
And after 13½ years, we’ve also finally learned how to cook, thereby displacing the conventional frozen pizza from the broader food meta.

But there are obviously two very specific projects you wanted to know about!
We all know what this is really about anyway, so we’ll set aside the annual outlook for the second half and get straight down to the nitty-gritty: SP9 and balancing – when’s it happening already?!

Entwell is currently concentrating entirely on the new Specialist Card and will likely present us with a first version before the end of June. However, we want to leave ourselves enough time to make any necessary changes to ensure you’ll be satisfied not only with the cards themselves but also everything to do with them. Based on this, we’re currently planning the release of SP9 for mid to late July. Of course, we’ll be dropping a few hints for you here or there in advance – the archer, for example, will be very spear-cial.

Balancing! We informed you in our last update that we’re preparing a test server so we can upload large balancing changes without putting the live environment at risk.
This project has since encountered a number of hurdles which make it impossible for us to implement it in a way we think it makes sense. While we will continue to pursue how to implement these servers in the background, you’ll still want to see changes, of course. 
And we’ll get them to you! – even if not all at once.

As we still do not want to take the risk of a single massive balancing update, we will roll out adjustments for individual specialists between content updates as often as possible.
We’ll start with the Death Reaper and Destroyer next week, followed up in the next round by the Fire Cannoneer and Tide Lords and Ladies.

Please let us know what you think about the changes. It won’t only help us in the following weeks, but also with any potential readjustments.

With these two topics out of the way, what else is planned for the rest of the year? At the moment, we’re totally focused on what we mentioned above, but here’s a little preview for you anyway!

As you can already see, we’re experimenting with a new type of event. This concerns a feature that we would like to expand to eventually provide daily, weekly and even seasonal quests and activities.

And of course we can’t leave out the new items in the form of costumes, pets, wings and more. Plus we’d like to make further adjustments to the EXP system, but we’ll talk more about that at a later date.

And finally, in case that wasn’t enough already, there miiight still be another large update hiding around the corner come the end of the year. It’s too early to clearly tell if and when or what that may be – for the moment, we can rest assured knowing there’ll be plenty more to talk about in our next, wonderful community update.

We’ll let that be all for now.

The exact changes to the Death Reaper and Destroyer will be announced separately in the coming days. Until then, we encourage you to keep an eye out for more SP9 teasers. 

We look forward to another, stupendous half year with you!
With a 60-Hour Maintenance!

The NosTale Team
