As a Chef, you first need to gather your materials, buy your spices, chop your ingredients, before you can set about cooking them. You’ll need certain skills for the various recipes which each have different preparation times.

In reward for your efforts, you can look forward to various titles to perfect your cooking skills with handy buffs. For especially tasty morsels you also stand a chance of picking up additional items.
À la carte
When preparing your recipes, there are certain things you have to watch out for to make sure you pull them off:
[olist]Some of the ingredients you collect cannot be cooked directly. You’ll need to chop them up with you skills first, either individually or multiple ingredients at once.Use recipes to prepare your chopped ingredients.Choose from three cooking methods: roast, simmer or stir fry.What you produce depends on your timing. Wait for the right moment to ‘Finish Cooking’. Keep your eyes on the dark steam rising from your meal to tell you it’s ready. If you finish too soon or too late, the meal will be ruined.Successfully cooking several meals will earn you cooking XP, a new higher-quality recipe, and you have a chance to get a Fortune Cake. Eat the Fortune Cake and you might get some handy items.If you mess up your cooking, you won’t receive these rewards.[/olist]
Cooking Skills
These are the skills at your disposal as a Chef:
Basic Attack: You attack with your wok.Cooking Preparation: You prepare everything you need for cooking. → Earns you cooking XP.Chop Ingredients: You prepare your ingredients.Sharpen Knife: You sharpen your cooking knife. → Gives you the chance to generate additional chopped ingredients or meals.Roast: You prepare a roast meal.    Simmer: You prepare a stew.Stir Fry: You prepare a difficult stir fry.    Secret Spice: You add a little secret spice to your meal. → Helps to make successful meals.Healthy Eating: You try to cook the meal without using spices. → Provides a chance not to consume any spices at all.Finish Cooking: You stop cooking. → Timing is of the essence!Voilà!: You proudly present your meal.
Finest Ingredients
Tasty Fruit and Veg
For your recipes you need only the best ingredients, such as the big new tomatoes, onions, mangos and lettuces which can be collected in NosTale!

Sweet or Sour
It takes the right combination of spices to turn a plain meal into a serious taste explosion. Chef Terry can provide you with fine spices such as garlic, chilli powder, cinnamon, and pepper. Meanwhile MSG can be looted by completing Act 7 raids.
For Gourmets
Before trying your hand at the more exquisite meals, you need to set Chef as your character’s side job. The first choice of side job is free, but each subsequent change costs 1,000,000 Gold.

You can acquire and equip the specialist card irrespective of your side job. But you can only transform into a Chef once you have selected it as your side job with Terry.

As a Chef, you can earn cooking XP by cooking meals and preparing ingredients, increasing the level of your specialist card.

The cooking XP depends on the level of meals you prepare.

The maximum level for Chef is 50.

The Chef is a down-to-earth specialist whose sights are only set on fine cuisine, so you can’t equip them with wings.

Look forward to extra culinary challenges. Chef Terry has daily quests ready for you as soon as you’ve finished the main quest.

Bon appétit!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Funktastic Monster Hunt
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/033e0d016a71e632434353688ed6d646b26efc68.jpg

The renowned scientist Dr Funkenstein has been beavering away in his laboratory, experimenting on ways to make pets even stronger. But he’s taken a dangerous path, using controversial techniques to splice their DNA together with strands from some of the more powerful monsters out there! He was on the cusp of making a major breakthrough, when something terrible happened… a loud bang, a fizz of sparks, and his entire experiment went up in smoke! Don’t worry, Dr Funkenstein is unharmed, but now all of his test subjects are running wild. That’s right, genetically modified monsters which could attack at any moment!

It’s now up to you to track down the runaway beasties. Dr Funkenstein is willing to offer you a generous reward for your help. (If you don’t help, he’ll have to pay a massive fine for his illegal experiments and for endangering the lives of young adventurers.)

Event Period: From 24th February (11 AM CET) to 3rd March (9 AM CET)
How the Event Works
Find the right map where the monsters are lurking.

Be in the right place at the right time, because the monsters will only come out at certain times.

Defeat the monsters, but be on your guard. They’re very strong and liable to use unusual attacks.

The monsters drop special loot you can take to Dr Funkenstein for valuable rewards.

Team up with other adventurers to hunt the monsters down more effectively.

The loot you collect is not tradeable and will land directly in your inventory. Every player who deals at least 5% of the damage to a monster will get the loot. But the monsters will slowly lose their health and disappear after about 40 minutes.
Let the Hunt Begin

Foxies like hiding in caves.Woolies enjoy munching grass and often hang around experimental facilities.Imps are attracted to magical areas.Jellies are most liable to be found in sandy regions.Hamsters like temples and ruins.Wolves prefer the shade of mountains and woods.Gimme the Loot

notes.title: New Server and Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Dear player,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to open a new international server and merge some language servers together. 

We’ve put together an FAQ covering everything about the new server and the server merge. Let’s start with the new server:

New International Server

The international server is the first one to be launched independent of language region. Enjoy an exciting start on the new server, and play in the language of your choice thanks to the multi-language client.


International Server FAQ

Eight languages in one chat? Won’t that get messy?
We thought about that, and as it’s an international server, we wanted to give everyone the chance to play here and use their own language. Otherwise we might as well just be launching another English server! Players who aren’t interested in seeing a mix of languages will still be able to play on the servers in their regions where the language is restricted. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on the situation, and may choose to restrict the language(s) used in the chat at a later date, should things get out of hand.

What about support? Which languages will that be provided in?
Ticket support for the international server will only be available in English.

Where can I go for server-related discussions?
We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord server. And if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

Are you planning anything special for the server launch?
As has become tradition for our server launches, we have a range of events and special offers planned for the launch. We’ll release more details on those over the coming days.

Server Merge
We’re merging the following servers together:
DE7 Paimon + DE2 Fortuna = Fortuna
ES6 Carno + ES1 EU-Infinity = EU-Infinity
FR7 Kirollas + FR2 Galaxie = Galaxie
IT5 Solaris + IT1 Flare = Flare
PL6 Belial + PL1 Feniks = Feniks

No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

Server Merge FAQ

How was it decided which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
There are multiple situations which can arise and will be solved as follows (the Swordsman, Archer and Mage classes are referred to here as ‘original’ classes):
Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.
Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 
Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
Click on Settings to open the account settings. Here you’ll land on the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. The two will be swapped.
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

What happens to families?
Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What happens to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What happens when two or more characters have the same name?
The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friends lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters to be activated after the transfer before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Do my login details remain unchanged?
Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Info on Planned Server Merge
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Dear players,

We’re soon merging some language servers to improve your gaming experience in NosTale! This will make it easier for us to merge servers in future, as well as allow us to launch international event servers in future.

The Merge
The following servers are being merged:

The servers RU Erenia, TR Sunucu and CZ Aeros are being merged into EN1 NosCitadel.
The server ES3 Theia is being merged into EN2 Cylloan.

Check our FAQ to find more details on the planned merges.

Server Merge FAQ

In order to improve your gaming experience in NosTale, we’ve seized the moment and merged together some language servers. You’ll find all the details to these merges in this FAQ.

Which servers are being merged?

 RU Erenia + TR Sunucu + CZ Aeros → EN1 NosCitadel
 ES3 Theia → EN2 Cylloan

No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

How was it decided which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What happens to families?
Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What happens to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What happens when two or more characters have the same name?
The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friends lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters to be activated after the transfer before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Do my login details remain unchanged?
Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

Can I now play the game in my language on every server?
You can create a new character on servers in other countries using your account, irrespective of the language you use in the client. Please consider however that the language in the chat on these servers may be handled differently.

How can I find my server in the server overview?
Players from Czechia, Russia and Turkey will find their characters on server 1 UK-NosCitadel in the English server section.
Players from ES2 Theia (America) will now find their characters on server 2 US-Cylloan in the English server section.
All other players’ characters are on the usual servers in their own language section.
By the way, the indicators now tell you how many characters you have on each server, making the selection easier to navigate.

Can I change the client language?
Yes, you can change the language in the Gameforge Client or on Steam and continue playing with your characters on your server.

Can I move my character to a different server?
No, that isn’t possible at the moment.

Do I need to select my server language in the overview every time?
The last language used will be automatically pre-selected next time.

My game won’t start or not in the language I want. What can I do?
Restart the Gameforge Client completely so that the latest version is downloaded. Make sure the update is fully complete before you start it again.

The links in the client are sending me to websites in the wrong language. How can I fix that?
This behaviour is linked to the display language chosen in the Gameforge Client. You can change this in the options at any time.

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 
Have fun on the new servers!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Roadmap 2021
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

As we put 2020 behind us, we say farewell to a turbulent and troublesome year, and not just in NosTale. Together we conquered the Celestial Spire, learned how to fish, and threw our keyboards out of the window after the third hotfix maintenance within a week!

But today’s not about NosTalgic reminiscences – you want to know what lies ahead! Together with Entwell, we’ll be working to bring you big updates and expansions this year… and probably a good bit of nail-biting on patch day.

Below you can find a list of our rough plans for the first half of the year, from January to June. As some of these updates lie several months down the road, there’s always the chance they’ll get pushed back into the second half of the year. So treat this list as a teaser of things to come, rather than a roadmap set in stone! But who are we talking to? We know you’ve all scrolled down past this already…

Planned updates for Q1 and Q2 2021:
International merges for EN/CZ/TR/RU and South America (for real this time!)International test and game server launchesFurther balance changesNew lifestyle specialist (similar to the Angler)New specialist for every classVarious mounts, pets, wings, costumes and more
Our seasonal and weekend events will continue as usual. And if the situation in the real world improves, we’ll hopefully squeeze in a few streams as well.Any questions, quibbles or queries about all that, talk to your favourite Community Manager. We hope you’re as excited about the future as we are!

Wishing you a great 2021!
The NosTale Team

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall!

notes.title: Event: Tough Time-Space Challenge

Listen up, brave hero! Princess Sakura has been kidnapped, and you’re the only one who has what it takes to be able to rescue her! 

But be on your guard, as sneaky Ninjas will be lurking in the shadows to stop you in your tracks. They are competent fighters, and love to lay an ambush so they can catch their opponents off guard. They’re not shy of killing their hostages either, so you’ll need to be move very carefully. The Ninjas’ fortress is a deathly labyrinth, with a sinister trick waiting in every room.

Do you have what it takes to rescue the princess from the Ninjas’ clutches and escape with both your lives intact?

Every hero remembers the first princess they rescued. And for this first rescue, you’ll receive the new ‘Ninja’ title which allows you to fight like a shadow warrior, giving you the Sharp Vision buff (revealing hidden characters for a short time) and briefly increasing hit rate and concentration.

Plus you’ll get 10 Small Completion Gemstone Random Boxes in reward.

Additional rewards:Think you’ve got both the brains and the brawn and want to get your hands on even more rewards? Then be among the 5 top players to leave the fortress safely in the fastest time!

The 5 players with the best times per server can look forward to the following juicy rewards:
Ninja BushtailPumpkin Witch/Pumpkin Knight CostumePumpkin Witch/Pumpkin Knight Costume Wings (Permanent)

notes.title: Winter Events and a Christmas Gift
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale! The wild cats are back once more, trying to take over in our Winter Event. What’s more, you have the special chance to create a reindeer-drawn sleigh – this sleek ride would make even Santa Claus turn green with envy, though at this festive time of year he can’t keep a merry smile off of his face at seeing you ride it.

Look forward to these highlights between 9th December 2020 and 13th January 2021:
Holiday Offers in the NosMall
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – including a festive Miniland decoration! 

Wondering why the sleigh isn’t on offer this winter? That’s because there are more than enough other Christmas items to buy. Besides, there’s another big surprise waiting behind the last door of our Advent calendar. What could it be…?
Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer
The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will create a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.
Specialist Partners
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger. With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. The partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up and Tiger Power
Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Simply use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you’re successful, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, possibly containing the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Obsidian of Completion.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.  
Daily QuestsSearching for the Siblings’ MotherSave the SiblingsNeed Sesame Oil
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.
Event Quest
Talk to the new Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the great items hidden inside.
Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.
Snowman Raid
Once you’ve completed the quest and mastered the Time-Space, you can get your revenge on the Snow Monster in the Vikings’ name. Grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward you’ll earn a raid box containing awesome specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.
The Search for Bigfoot
Another Bigfoot sighting has been reported in NosVille: The mysterious creature who doesn’t exactly live life as large as the footprints it leaves behind has been seen in the snowy mountains. The tracks in the snow apparently resemble those of a tiger… Can you get to the bottom of this mystery? Complete the quest successfully to obtain the new ‘Bigfoot’ title!
Sealed Christmas Vessel
You can summon monsters with the Sealed Christmas Vessel. This time, you can obtain the new ‘Grinch’ title from these monsters.
Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.
Happy New Year… Literally!
Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If fortune’s smiling, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful Winter Event!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: New: The Angler Specialist Card
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b72757c53689a73979517a04d7cb9f2388cabe46.jpg

Are you in need of a little downtime away from the sometimes rather hectic NosTale action, but you’re still looking for a little challenge? How about some fishing? Our new Angler Specialist Card offers you just that:

Relax by the water and reel in a nice fat fish. Discover all there is to know about your catches to date in the Encyclopaedia of Fish and keep on getting better. 
All Fish Great and Small
All sorts of fish in various sizes await you in the waters of NosTale. You can catch a total of 77 fish, some of which are only to be found in certain areas. Fish that you’ve caught will be entered into your Encyclopaedia of Fish. This is where you’ll find an overview of all the fish and the areas in which you’ll find them.

Once you’ve completed your collection, you’ll be the proud owner of a new title: ‘Champion Angler’.
Angler’s A to Z
With our Angler’s A to Z, your next catch is already in the bag:
[olist]You’ll receive the new Angler Specialist Card via a quest given by Fisherman Wade, whom you’ll find in NosVille.In order to start fishing, you’ll need consumables from Fisherman Wade’s Fishing Tackle Shop.You’ll then need to equip your new specialist card and get the fish to bite using your skills.All that remains now is to be patient. As soon as the fish has bitten, try to lift it out of the water. You’ll need to time it just right or the fish will slip through your fingers.[/olist]Cast Your Line
A NosTale angler has a good command of the following skills:

Basic Attack: You attack monsters with your fishing rod.
Cast Line: You cast your line with bait.Reel In: You try to pull the fish out of the water.
Bait Fishing: You use reusable bait.
Teleport to Fishing Spot: Fast-travel for anglers.
Covert Fishing: You and your NosMates remain undetected.
What a Whopper!: A real angler shows just how proud they are of their catch.
Got a Bite: You draw your opponent towards you.
Fish-Fish Dance: You ask the Fish Loa for his blessing.
Maintain Fishing Line: Mends and reinforces your line.
Cast Line (Pro): Increases the chances of catching a fish.
Got a Bite!
What you need to know about fishing in NosTale:
If you want licence to whip out your fishing rod out in each of the 22 areas, you’ll need to level up your specialist card – and that, as you’ve already guessed, is achieved by fishing!The bigger the fish you catch, the more experience you’ll gain. Your level increases accordingly, up to a maximum of level 50.You can also look forward to more challenges in the realm of fishing sports: Fisherman Wade will have new fishing quests ready for you every day once you’ve finished the main quest.
Tight lines!
The NosTale Team

NosVille’s heroes love a spectacle, and have recently come together to announce a big competition! But they don’t want to compete against one another this time around. Instead, this will be a competition in the spirit of cooperation, working towards to the same goal, in a Raid Marathon to earn as many points as possible. But they will only be victorious if everyone joins the fun and does their bit!

Join the massive Raid Marathon and earn a higher perfection rate for you and your community:

When? Between 13th November (midnight) and 19th November (11:59 PM CET)!
How It Works
Each time a raid is completed, every player in the group will earn a certain number of points. Some raids reward you with 1 point, while others give you up to 5 points. All the points your raid party earn will be added to the total for the whole Gameforge family. 

Now here’s the rub: every 100,000 points the community earns will increase the perfection chance in the upcoming Perfection Event by 1% – up to a maximum of 50%!

Want to see the current event progress? Then visit our website and see what the community’s achieved so far.

The Perfection Event will take place between 20th November (4 PM) and 23rd November (10 AM CET).

notes.title: Community Update – Merges and Balancing
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hello NosPlayers!

As we enter the final quarter of the year, we wanted to reach out and talk about what’s currently in the pipeline, what plans we have, and what problems lie ahead.

Today’s community update focuses on two main issues – the international server merges and the next balancing patch – and the reasons why neither is quite ready!

Last week we made the difficult decision to push the server merges we’d had pencilled down for November back into next year. We know that many of you will be annoyed to hear this, and we totally understand – in fact, nobody’s more put out by this than we are! Be that as it may, we want to be as open and frank as we can about both the reasons behind this decision, and where we’re going from here.

The aim of the server merges is to pool the smaller communities into a larger one, yet still allow each player to choose the language version they want to play the game in. NosTale currently has 9 completely separate setups and databases across all languages, making this project far more complicated than simply throwing together servers from within the same territory.

We need more time than originally budgeted for to ensure that no accounts slip through our digital fingers, and all the servers can be merged without a hitch. But enough of our excuses! Let’s come to what you really want to know: when are the merges coming? Well, if everything goes according to the current plan, we should be able to get this underway early next year. We don’t have a concrete date yet, but we’ll keep you posted as things progress.

What does all this have to do with the eagerly awaited balancing patch? Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about that. One request on a lot of players’ lips is for more and deeper-running changes. While we’ve already taken a number of steps in this direction, the last thing we want to do is release a patch which knocks everything out of kilter – and let’s be honest, that wouldn’t be the first time. So we’ve come up with another solution…

Introducing the Public Experimental Server for Testing Stuff (or PESTS – okay, fine, the name is still WIP)!

That’s right, we want to hear your feedback to any changes we make as directly as we can, so we’re working on setting up a public test server where you can try out all our experimental tweaks and adjustments first hand. It’s important to us that everyone has a fair say, so we didn’t want make this an exclusively English server. Once the international merges are complete, we plan to roll out an international server as a test playground, where everyone can mess around and play with all the toys.

But that’s why the next big balancing patch is directly linked to the server merges.

Fine, so is there anything coming out this year?! Don’t worry, we’ve still got plenty in the pipeline to publish over the next few months. Keep your breath baited and fish around for clues, and you might even find a few hints about the next specialist coming to NosVille.

As ever, we’d like to thank you for being patient, and apologise for these delays. You’re what makes NosTale so amazing even after 13 years, and we cannot thank you enough. Have a great October and see you next update!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update Ready to Launch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c8f9c4fb7340d40165112e655da71fb632527bc9.jpg

Our next update brings improvements to the NosBazaar, the popular and handy auction house, plus a new PvP encounter with the Arena of Glory! Learn more details about what to expect below.
NosBazaar Improvements
We’ve long felt the NosBazaar could be a bit easier to use, wouldn’t you agree? Well, you’ll be pleased to hear that we’re introducing the following improvements:
Hovering over an item will now bring up some handy info, such as whether it is soulbound or whether it has any effects.Use a search filter for your specialist cards and see their perfection level at a glance.A new category has been added to armour for costumes and costume wings. That way you can easily search for costume items for your chosen gender (unisex items are displayed for both). Similarly, we’ve added a category for titles.The equipment search for champion levels has been expanded.Arena of Glory
Looking to get stuck into the action without any messing around? A challenge in which victory and defeat are decided purely based on skill? Then the new PvP arena is right up your street! All you need are your tenacity and fighting skills!
No groups are allowed in the Arena of Glory. It’s every man for himself!Pets must wait outside. As much as we love our pets and partners, they’re not allowed in the Arena of Glory and will have to wait in the Miniland for your glorious return.An extra challenge – no buffs! There’ll be no one giving you buffs in this arena, a rule you might be familiar with from the Celestial Spire.Riding items and potions are similarly banned from the arena. The only exception to this are items like Fairy Boosters or Tarot Cards.If you use a skill, players will still be able to attack you even in the safe zone for 10 seconds. That’s designed to prevent players dashing back to the safe zone in cowardly hit-and-run attacks.Another 10-second timer starts ticking after leaving the raid via a portal.Skill Changes
We’ve made a few tweaks to some passive buffs to improve class balance.

We’re sure you’re going to love these features and changes. We hope you have fun – not long to wait now until release!

notes.title: Guide: Infinite Celestial Spire Rankings
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7cc81bcac28e443b957042245ab9cea835762fc3.jpg

The update’s here, bringing with it a new challenge for you! How good do you think you are? Battle your way up the Infinite Celestial Spire and earn your spot under the best combatants in the new rankings table. Depending on your final place, you could get your hands on some great rewards.We’ve also reworked the spire’s difficulty and given your inventory an upgrade. Read up on all the gory details in this guide:
Rankings
Rules
Your ranking is primarily based on the highest level you’ve managed to complete in the Infinite Celestial Spire. The second criterion is then the time you needed to complete the level, and finally your level in the spire (to which your champion level is added).Ranking Details:
There’s a different table for each classYou automatically qualify if you complete at least one level of the spireRankings are reset at 5:00 AM (CEST) on the first day of every month, removing all previous rankingsThe lists are updated daily at 3:00 AM (CEST)You receive rewards for top places when the ranking lists are reset. Rewards are sent by parcel
Ranking Overview
You can see the full lists in the Celestial Spire Rankings and Rewards List menus. Simply click on the new buttons Season Reward and Ranking Info to open up the respective window.
Rewards
Rewards depend on your spot in the rankings, with different rewards for 1st place, 2nd/3rd place, 4th–10th place, 11th–20th place and 21st–30th place. Each reward consists of a treasure chest containing a certain amount of gold, fame and Infinity Coins. Check the overview in the game to see a complete list of rewards.
Celestial Spire Shop Items
You can use your Infinity Coins to purchase the following items in the Celestial Spire:
Golden Celestial Spire ChestSpirit King Gloves (Replica)Ancient Beast Gloves (Replica)Ancient Beast Shoes (Replica)Spirit King Shoes (Replica)Inventory Update
After the update you’ll find a new button in the inventory for sorting your items. Simply click the button to activate it. Please note that you cannot use the sorting feature while trading.
Difficulty Adjustment
Too difficult? We’ve gone and reduced the overall difficulty of the spire, and updated some of the levels for a smoother gaming experience. There’s now nothing stopping you from conquering the Infinite Celestial Spire – show ‘em who’s boss!

Wow, are you still reading this? Well you couldn’t be better prepared for the new competition in the Infinite Celestial Spire. Go get ‘em! Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Guide: Infinite Celestial Spire
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/95eb85259a3ea7160f328fbfe72357885c888204.jpg

Hello adventurers, 

As announced in our news about the highlights of Act 7 Part 2, you’ll have a new and exciting challenge to face in the Infinite Celestial Spire. And we’ve summarised all the important details for you here.

What Is It?

You enter the Infinite Celestial Spire and take on dangerous monsters that attack in waves on several levels. Your task is to defend the totem against the attackers. You’ll be supported in your efforts by powerful groups of pets and partners. This game mode is suitable for single players and PvE lovers. 

NosMates

The special thing about this feature is that you can take 5 groups consisting of 4 NosMates each into the Celestial Spire with you. Your companions will lend you active support in your battles – and you’re going to need it! If certain NosMates are part of the same group, they can give you teamwork buffs.

You can summon your NosMates during battle if you need reinforcements. Simply click on the icons 1 to 5 or press the SHIFT + 1 to 5 keys.

Infinite Celestial Spire

The entry conditions for the Infinite Celestial Spire are:


 You must have completed the new main quest.
 You mustn’t currently be part of a party.
 The Celestial Spire Key item is required.


If you meet all the conditions, speak to the gatekeeper in the village of Moritius. Before entering the Spire, you will be shown a new menu. Here you can put together your groups of NosMates to accompany you in battle.

The New Game Mode

These are the rules:


 All buffs are removed when you enter the Spire.
 Consumables cannot be used.
 You can change specialist cards, fairies and gear during the battles.
 NosMates only receive 50% damage in the Spire.
 Your friends cannot teleport to you inside the Spire.


Winning and losing:


 There is at least one totem on each level, which you have to defend for a certain amount of time against the waves of monsters. You can position your NosMate groups around the totem to help you with this.
 You have to survive, of course. But it’s also important to protect the totem until the end of each level! If just one of the totems is destroyed, you will fail your mission. You can repeat the lost level with a Celestial Spire Key.
 If you survive the level and the totems haven’t been destroyed, you will complete the level.
 You can reset all completed levels using the Celestial Spire Reset Ticket so that you can play them again. However, you will only receive the normal and random rewards when playing them again.


The monsters and the totem:

The totem gets stronger with each level – as do the monsters. They only have one thing on their minds: to destroy the totem! When they appear, they will rush straight for it. Only once you or your NosMates attack the monsters will they turn their aggression towards you and your companions.

But monsters wouldn’t be monsters if there weren’t any deviants: some of them won’t take their eyes off the totem even when you hit them, while others will show greater hostility towards you and your little NosMate army. So be on your guard!

The Rewards

Let’s finally turn our attention to the rewards that are in store for your efforts! There are three of them, depending on how you complete the Infinite Celestial Spire:


 Normal reward: Gold and reputation
 Random reward: various random rewards such as the Infinity Coin (a new currency), Celestial Spire Key, Raid Seal etc.
 Bonus: only available for the first completion in each month. You’ll receive rewards like the Infinity Coin, Celestial Spire Key, Raid Seal, materials, consumables etc.


The Celestial Spire Shop

In the new Celestial Spire Shop, you can get everything you need for your battles in the Infinite Celestial Spire and more. You can spend your Infinity Coins on useful items here too.


So, those were all the important details. If you have actually read this far, you are now well-prepared for your new adventure in the Infinite Celestial Spire. Let’s go! Your NosMates are waiting impatiently for you.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg

Hey NosPlayers!

In March of this year we shared the first Community Update with you celebrating how far we had gotten as well as sharing an outlook on things we were working on.
As we are now heading into the second half of the year, it’s time to look back – as well as forward.

2020 has certainly been a turbulent year, forcing all of us here at Gameforge into home office, where we have now been for the better part of 3 months.
Nonetheless, we were able to achieve many of our goals bringing you important updates for the future of the game like our new client or the national merges. How are you merged people feeling in your new homes?

Of course, we have to admit that not everything on our list will be completed in this first half of 2020.
With all our efforts focused on delivering Act 7.2 to you as soon and flawlessly as possible, the new specialist or international merges will have to wait until after that. We apologize for this delay.
Worry not though – we haven’t forgotten! They’re being carried over at the top of our new list.

And while we’re on the topic, let’s get into it! (Since we are planning the 7.2 release for next month, it’s no longer on this list)
Things we will be working on in the second half of the year include:

 Community Merges for EN/CZ/RU/TR/South America
 Changes to EXP in Quest Progression
 New Specialist System
 SP Balancing
 New Wings, Costumes and Miniland Decorations
 Several QoL features
 Bugfixes and other improvements


Like last time, there will also be seasonal and boost events starting with a summery event rather soon.
So grab your straw hats, buckle up and join us for the ride!

With sincere thanks for your patience,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e51d4512a76f4ef06810b03b45221c0c49daee86.jpg

In order to improve your gaming experience in NosTale, we will seize the moment and merge together some of our language servers. You will be able to have fun on the newly merged servers and enjoy full raids and events – and of course get to welcome new family members!

The following servers will be merged:
* DE6 Zenas + DE2 Fortuna = Fortuna
* ES5 EU-Phoenix + ES1 EU-Infinity = EU-Infinity
* FR6 Univers + FR2 Galaxie= Galaxie
* PL5 Radikun + PL1 Feniks = Feniks

No changes will be made to any servers not mentioned.

Any questions?

What will happen to my characters and family? Will my friends list be deleted? We answer all these and many more questions in our FAQ!

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team 

Server Merge FAQ 
In order to improve your gaming experience in NosTale, we will seize the moment and merge together some of our language servers. You’ll find all the details to these merges in this FAQ.

Which servers are being merged?
The following servers will be merged:
* ES5 + ES1 = ES1 (on April 28th)
* DE6 + DE2 = DE2 (on April 29th)
* FR6 + FR2 = FR2 (on April 29th)
* PL5 + PL1 = PL1 (on April 29th)
No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

How was it decided which servers to merge together?
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
There are multiple situations which can arise and will be solved as follows (the Swordsman, Archer and Mage classes are referred to here as ‘original’ classes):
Situation 1: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.
Situation 2: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 
Situation 3: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
Situation 4: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
*Log into the website at nostale.gameforge.com, by clicking on "Settings" in the Launcher.
*You can also use the character activation on the website if you play the game via Steam. Simply ask the support team to link your Steam account to your website account, if it is not already linked.
* Check your character list on the website. You’ll find them in the settings.
* If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. The two will be swapped.
* Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

What happens to families?
Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

What happens to the family warehouse?
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

What happens when two or more characters have the same name?
The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

What happens when two or more families have the same name?
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team  to change the family name manually.

What happens to items in the warehouse?
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

What happens to friends lists and spouses?
As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

Will the rankings be reset?
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

What happens to the blacklist?
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible. 

Do I have to delete or select the characters to be activated after the transfer before the server merge?
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Do my login details remain unchanged?
Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team  will be happy to help. 
Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: New Game Client for NosTale
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/431861591e7724964684630a320a255a9802b57f.jpg

Coming soon to NosTale – we’re switching our client to a new multilingual version. Learn the most important details about the new game client below.

Changes
Instead of having nine different game clients, one for each language, NosTale’s adventurers can all launch their favourite game from the same common client!

This multilingual version will include all NosTale languages. While it makes for a slightly larger download, this is outweighed by the benefits it brings.

Benefits
Players who play multiple language versions now only need one game client. Gone are the days of having to update each individual version separately: simply switch between game languages in the Gameforge Client or the Steam settings.

But that’s not all! We’re working on even more improvements:

Introducing a multilingual game client is only the first step. In future it will be possible to play on all servers in all languages with the new client – with the same account!

We also want to make it possible to merge the different versions into an international server. The client should also make it possible to play international events.

As you can see, we’ve got a lot up our sleeves and we can’t wait to roll out the next updates. As ever, we’ll keep you posted on the latest developments in our news.

Want to find out more about the new game client? Learn more in our FAQ !

The NosTale Team
FAQ: Multilingual Client
Here you can learn more about the multilingual client. 

Why is NosTale getting a multilingual client?
The multilingual client is the first step towards international server merges. 

What will happen to my accounts and characters?
Don’t worry, nothing will change about your accounts and characters.

Can I use the multilingual client to play on a different server than my chosen language (e.g. on a Polish server in English)?
In future we certainly plan to make it possible to play on other servers than your chosen language, however this isn’t possible at the moment. The language chosen in the Gameforge Client determines which servers you can join. For example, if your Gameforge Client is set to English, you can only play on UK/US servers.More details regarding these changes will be announced once we’re closer to releasing them. 

Do I need to select the server and language every time I log in?
No, there will be no change here. The language chosen and saved in the Gameforge Client still determines which server you play on.

How much space does the multilingual game client require?
The installation size will increase from 4.8 GB to around 5.8 GB, however the download is smaller as the files are compressed during transfer.

notes.title: Guide: Tattoo System
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/45ba5d6da0b4d05ef7f13e9f99f84c5e2117cb2b.jpg

This update will get under your skin! In NosTale Act 7, you can visit Churisgo on Moritius and have her give you a magical tattoo. You’ll feel the extra power boost immediately!

Tattooing has a long tradition on the island of Moritius. The orcs pay homage to the god of wild animals with their skin art, who in turn bestows special blessings on the bearer of the tattoos in the form of special abilities. Churisgo is a true master of this traditional art.

You can choose between tattoos from these 4 categories:
* Bear Loa
* Lion Loa
* Eagle Loa
* Snake Loa

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6e9b78d1281a7ff264a5f636b2275df05cb44934.jpg

How it works:
*    Visit NPC Churisgo in the village on the island of Moritius.
*    Talk to the orc Churisgo.
*    You require materials with which to craft a tattoo pattern.
*    Use the tattoo pattern to choose one of the tattoo categories.
*    You’ll receive a random tattoo which grants you a passive ability. There are 8 different tattoos in each category.
*    Your character can have up to two tattoos. These must be from different categories, however.
*    You can also ask Churisgo to touch up an existing tattoo and strengthen the ability it provides. As this is a difficult procedure, the result may be successful, unsuccessful or a major failure. Failure results in the strength of the effect dropping by 1.
*    Each tattoo can be strengthened up to 9 times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0eaf6ddb3f18d132806797076907c10ef58389a6.jpg

Please note: Materials are required for each step up to a complete tattoo (creating the pattern, adding the tattoo and strengthening it).

notes.title: Guide: Runes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/703e2ff8e9eaaedbc9ecf4005c1aa6baa2704490.jpg

The inhabitants of Moritius Island use the mysterious and powerful runes to make their weapons stronger.

As you are helping the orcs on the island, rune master Martas is happy to carve these magical runes into your weapons too.

How it works:

 Visit NPC Martas on the new region, Moritius Island.
 He'll carve runes into your weapon in exchange for money and materials.
 You can carve up to 15 runes into your weapon (any weapon of level 80 or above).
 The more runes you try to add, the higher the chance that the process will fail.
 Each rune will have a different effect. If you get the same effect more than once, the effect is amplified.
 For every 3 runes you carve, there is a chance for a rune power to be applied to your weapon instead of an effect.
 Just like rune effects, rune powers can stack when you get the same power more than once.
 Applying a rune can have the following outcomes: successful, unsuccessful, or ruined. If a rune is ruined, you won’t be able to carve any more runes.
 There are 13 rune effects, and 10 rune powers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/3ff772a4266d6532344b520da77a45a10fd40891.jpg

Resources in the NosMall

So you’re not happy with the effects you got and want to remove all your runes? Or you want to repair a ruined rune?

Why not take a look in the NosMall? You’ll find plenty of things there to help make you a happy rune user.

Have fun upgrading your weapon!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Witching Hour in NosTale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a509ffd737e063983c9a7fb6143b8e0ff60d63e7.jpg

Double, double toil and trouble, hear the fires of Hellord bubble!
Witches, devils, ghosts and sprites, walk abroad this eerie night.
When monsters lurk on NosVille’s greens, you know it’s time for Halloween!
​
Get ready ‘twixt 24th October and 13th November when NosTale will be visited by the crazy Professor Macavity, Foxy and her fiendish brood, plus Jack O’Lantern and his minions! 
​
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these new **titles with amazing effects** in the raid box:

 Test Subject
     Effect: Increases resistance to Bleeding by 1%.
Sly Dog
     Effect: Increases max. MP by 300.
 Horror
     Effect: Increases damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.

​
Mad Professor Macavity
​
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject, and the chase can begin!

Full details on the raid:
* Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.
* The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.
* Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.
* Players who want to play must bring a pet.
* Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.
* Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.
* Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. 
* Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.
* The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Players caught leave the raid without a box.
* If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.
* White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
​
Foxy and Her Brood
​
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest, which with a bit of good fortune might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card.
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!
​
The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.
​
Jack O’Lantern and His Minions
​
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.
​
Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs
Talk to with Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
* Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.
* Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat and set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.
* Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
​
Best witches!
The NosTale Team

Equal opportunities for everyone – join the server right from the start and stake your claim in the highscore tables. Plus you can earn cool titles in our exciting events.

Time: Early evening around 6 PM CEST

Earn a title and exploit its effects!

The title system is something new to NosTale. Once you’ve earned yourself a title, it will be displayed beneath your character name after activation. The titles come with buffs which strengthen your character. Plus they show other players immediately who they’re dealing with.
You can find full details on the title system here.

notes.title: The Small Ice Witch Hiding in Sealed Vessels!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/8e2a9fe7b969ea55c6e8619fa27f25897c1ebdc4.jpg

The Small Ice Witch could be your next loyal companion.

With her frosty blue dress and the icicles growing from her purple hair, she looks pretty cool, even when she’s not floating along alongside you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/34ceb031fb83d254064b3981678d8faa9c6edca7.gif

Effects:
 	Attacks have a 10% probability of causing Freeze. This leaves your opponent unable to move for 8 seconds.
 	Defence: 40% chance of reducing water attack damage by 90%.

If fortune smiles on you, you may find the Small Ice Witch in one of the mysterious Sealed Vessels that are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only parties of experienced adventurers should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages.
The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest containing fantastic items from the NosMall.

Event period: From 24th July (11 AM CEST) until 7th August (11 AM CEST)

How it works:

 	Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.
 	Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.
 	Open the Sealed Vessel releasing one of 20 monsters.
 	The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall, and with a pinch of good fortune, maybe even the Small Ice Witch.

Things to know:

 	The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.
 	Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus) or at Sunset Cliff.
 	Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).
 	The event will be repeated in future with another amazing reward.


In addition to the treasure chest, the following items may drop after defeating the monster:

 	1x Small Ice Witch (Pet)
 	1x Sheriff Chloe’s Specialist Partner Card
 	1x Guardian Lucifer’s Specialist Partner Card
 	1x Archdaemon Amon’s Specialist Partner Card
 	2x Wings of Friendship
 	1x Tarot Card Game
 	5x Fairy Experience Potion
 	20x Perfume
 	20x Huge Recovery Potion
 	10x Cylloan Spring Water
 	40x Seed of Power
 	10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing
 	1x Special Pet Food


Wishing you the best of luck!
The NosTale Team

Red vs. Blue: The Rainbow Crystal Battle has been freshly reworked with matchmaking and cool prizes! You’ll need to display teamwork, raw strength and tactics in your mission to turn the most Rainbow Crystals your team’s colour in the allotted time.#####

Fair Battles in Brand-New Matchmaking

Here’s how it works:
The Rainbow Crystal Battle icon will appear in the interface at certain times.Enter for free with a single click.A minimum of 10 players and a maximum of 30 can take part in each battle.If more than 30 players join, more instances will launch.Each battle lasts 7 minutes.

notes.title: [3/7–31/7/2019] A Summer of Fun with Captain Pete O’Peng and Lola Lopears!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/2762bbe59c1ff7619313980440e19c6f09c669be.jpg

This year’s summer event is here! Your favourite villains are back centre stage. Are you going to take on the fearsome pirate Captain Pete O’Peng? Or would you prefer to give the mischievous Lola Lopears a tug on the lugholes? You can take them both to task and pick up great event items until 31st July.

More Dangerous Than Ever: Captain Pete O’Peng!

Yo-ho-ho, Captain Pete O’Peng is back! After voyaging the seven seas, he’s returned… and he’s badder than ever before! He’ll be causing mischief again this summer and he reckons you won’t stand a chance against him this time. What do you say to that? Show that rascally freebooter what you’re made of!
Eliminate the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona or one of the four Pirate Bushtails amongst many other items.Slip on the elegant Navy Costume! The Captain’s Hat provides a 2% chance of inflicting Strong Freeze on your opponent. The costume provides a 5% chance of reducing all attack damage by 80%. Both items of clothing increase your water resistance by 2%.
Give Lola Lopears a Tug on the Lugholes!

It’s Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

Event Quests

A host of challenging quests will demand your utmost skill. You’ll be rewarded with Ginseng Leaves and Carrots, and these handy items will help you by regenerating HP and MP.

Daily Quests

Ginseng Digger and Raphael’s Story
As a reward for the daily quests, you’ll find the Tortoise Present and Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal.

The NosTale Team

notes.title: [Until 28/6, 11AM] Dracula Random Box: Boost your champion EXP by +30%!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/9181108331a24c48a9cceb766c5306ad8bfbdfaf.jpg

Something brushes past you in the darkness. What was that? You spin around, and out of the corner of your eye you think to catch a glimpse of what looks like a deep black cloak disappearing. *click* From somewhere a torchlight sheds a beam of light, casting a sinister game of shadows as it inches along the wall. In a sudden puff of smoke, a musty old chest materialises at your feet. You gaze at it in surprise, as a piece of paper wafts gently down to land on the dark wood.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/0f442a7934de443dd1f67aee28b95bb7098feb0d.jpg

Peering at the note in the dim light, you make out a sentence scratched in red ink (or is it blood?): ‘Search the NosMall until 28th June 2019.’

With a loud ‘knack’ you unlatch the Dracula Random Box, in the knowledge that one of the following items must be contained within:
Dracula SetPuppet Master’s Set (only for girls)Puppet Master’s Bear Set (only for boys)Magic Sleigh30x Sealed Vessels30x Soulstone Blessing3x Tarot Card Game60x Cylloan Spring Water1x Magic Speed Booster (7 Days)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/9ed5c8e1415ea297efa083b243d7ef9359e45afe.jpg

‘Just the thing for a trainee bloodsucker and passionate puppet master!’ you think, closing your eyes and reaching into the depths of the chest. The Dracula Set is especially tempting, as it grants you a total of +30% champion experience alongside other cool effects.

Your hands close around the item and you slowly pull it out.
What will it be?

Find out in the NosMall!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: [23–30/5] Leo Hops into a Random Box for World Turtle Day!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/1e738fd8c4408568d8234c71a5916e76825f3a3a.jpg

Hey, my name’s Leo!

As you might have noticed, I’m a turtle, and today’s a very special day for me – that’s right, 23rd May is World Turtle Day! What better reason could there be for a very special random box. And best of all, it’s got my name on it!

Some people call me a coward, but that’s not really fair. The truth is… well, I’m shy is all. But not if the right music’s playing. Then I really come out of my shell!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/d191bb0ff8401cb8c77a06e627855b635a87614b.gifhttps://en-blog-nostale.gameforge.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/2019-04-26_NT_Leo_GIF_V02.gif

So how about it? Wouldn’t you like to have a party animal like me as your pet? With a bit of good luck, you’ll find me as the jackpot in Leo’s Random Box. You can buy it in the NosMall between 23rd and 30th May 2019.

Everyone wants to have me. Understandable really. But as I’m rather shy, I won’t climb into every box. Still, no need to worry, there are loads of other great items waiting for you in the random boxes.

Leo’s Random Box contains 1 random item:
Jackpot: Leo the CowardFairy Wings15x Gourmet Pet Food30x Soulstone Blessing120x Huge Recovery Potion1x NosMate Summoning Book8x Fairy Booster5x Tarot Card Game30x Sealed Vessels5x Treasure Chest Skeleton Key
The items will be delivered to you unpacked. That is, all except for me of course – I’m always packing my sexy shell!

notes.title: [10/4–4/6] Challenge of the Week – Are You Marriage Material Yet?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/1ffed2840ea64637e8e342f9cbbb73b3740ba11f.jpg

A mysterious fortune-teller is visiting NosVille between 10th April and 4th June. She’ll help to turn you into proper marriage material, giving you new tasks in 3 different difficulties every week.

When you enter the dim room, a dizzy feeling overcomes you. Your eyes gradually adjust to the weak candlelight, and you spot the source of that overpowering smell of musk, in the dozens of glimmering incense sticks.

What have you let yourself in for? While toying with the idea of simply leaving again, a mysterious voice breaks the silence and interrupts your train of thought.

‘Don’t back out now!’

You swallow hard and edge imperceptibly closer to the fortune teller, who is visiting the world of NosTale until 4th June.

After all, you would like to find out what – and indeed WHO – the future has in store for you.

‘Come a little closer. Closer than that! Shh, shh, no need to say anything. I know all about you! Don’t look so surprised. My name is Madame Esmeralda, a psychic and the saviour of your love life! Now let me see here... hmm... a little rough around the edges, but you’re not a hopeless case. Don’t worry, Esmeralda knows exactly how to make proper marriage material out of you.’

Madame Esmeralda gestures for you to take a look in her crystal ball and see what the coming weeks hold in store for you:

     Each week you’ll be faced with 2 challenges each with 3 difficulty levels. If you succeed, your Marriage Material rating will increase by 2, 4 or 7 percent in reward, depending on the chosen difficulty level (bronze, silver or gold).
     The challenges themselves will appear shortly before the start here: View challenges
     Once all the ‘Challenges of the Week’ are over, your total will be tallied up. The fantastic prizes, large and small, will be awarded according to how well you’ve proven your worth as Marriage Material.


Prizes? What prizes? As if answering your thoughts, one item after another appears in the crystal ball:

>7% Marriage Material --> 3x Fairy Booster (Event)
>14% Marriage Material --> 3x Soulstone Blessing (Event)
>21% Marriage Material --> 3x Ancelloan’s Blessing (Event)
>28% Marriage Material --> 20x Angel’s Feather
>35% Marriage Material --> 20x Full Moon Crystal
>42% Marriage Material --> 5x Yellow Gem (= 50,000 Gold)
>49% Marriage Material --> 5x Green Gem (= 150,000 Gold)
>56% Marriage Material --> 3x Blue Gem (= 300,000 Gold)
>63% Marriage Material --> 3x NosMerchant Medal (1 Day/Event)
>69% Marriage Material --> 3x Adventurer’s Knapsack (10 Days/Event)
>72% Marriage Material --> 3x Partner’s Backpack (10 Days/Event)
>75% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Ruby of Completion
>78% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Sapphire of Completion
>81% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Obsidian of Completion
>84% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Topaz of Completion
>87% Marriage Material --> 1x Wedding Costume Specialist Card
>91% Marriage Material --> 5x Treasure Chest Skeleton Key (Limited)
>98% Marriage Material --> 1x Giant Lump of Gold (= 1 million Gold)

Note: If you have reach 21% Marriage Material, for example, you’ll receive the prize for 21%, as well as those for 14% and 7%.

While your imagination paints you a picture of a rosy future with your loved one, Madame Esmeralda impatiently taps her foot.

‘So, you got all that?’ Her husky voice tears you out of your daydream. You nod enthusiastically.

‘Fine, then get out of here! And don’t forget you can always find the new weekly challenges here.’

Fully invigorated by what you’ve seen, you set off determined to become the very epitome of eligible marriage material.

Have fun!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Brand-New Family System
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/31479df3277f8dad72317bc533ee5e6c4f90b129.jpg

You can now achieve amazing things with your NosTale family. We’ve given the family system a major overhaul, allowing you to earn epic rewards for fighting together with your kin!

Coming new to NosTale, you’ll find family missions, achievements and rewards, plus a reworked family rankings system.
Read about all the details and which changes and adventures you can look forward to you on your next family outing:

Family Level
The maximum family level will be increased from 10 to 20.

Family Achievements
Completing family missions allows you to unlock achievements for your family and increase your family level.

Family Missions
As your family progresses, you’ll unlock missions for you to complete. Some of these are daily missions, others monthly. For example, you may need to complete a certain raid 5 times, or complete 10 Instant Combats.

Family Rewards
Your family earns rewards for completing missions and achievements. There are four types of reward:


Family Skills

 Increase the XP you earn or unlock benefits for Glacernon (Act 4), amongst other things.
 This applies to all family members, but some skills also help all players of your faction.
 Applies for one month.
 Can be used by Family Head or Family Deputy once per day.


Family Buffs
These include, for example, increasing attack and defence power by up to 10%, or increasing the effectiveness of food/potions by up to 15%. You can also increase the number of family members (up to 100) or the size of your family warehouse (up to 49 slots).
Applies to all family members.
Permanent effect.
Can be purchased by the Family Head from Family Manager Salim for gold.

Family Experience – FXP

By fulfilling daily missions and achievements you receive family experience, labelled as FXP.
These points allow you to improve your family and climb the rankings.


Family Emblems

The most valuable things for players are the ‘emblems’ which are displayed next to the family name (these are only rewarded to the top-ranked families in the three monthly rankings).


Monthly Rankings
There are three different monthly rankings. The top-placed family of each will be rewarded with family emblems and other prizes.

Monthly FXP Rankings
Win this ranking by having earned more FXP than any other family.
Monthly Family Rankings (Angels)
Win this ranking by earning more PvP points than any other family in the Angel faction in Glacernon (Act 4).
Monthly Family Rankings (Demons)
Win this ranking by earning more PvP points than any other family in the Demon faction in Glacernon (Act 4).

Note: At the moment all top-ranked families receive a debuff designed to prevent them from monopolising the top spot as a result of all their bonus effects and skills. This debuff gets stronger month by month (up to 30% after 3 months).

Action Points

Each player can earn ‘action points’ for playing raids and similar activities. In the family info, these indicate which players have been most active. But don’t confuse action points for FXP – only FXP allows you to level up your family.
Members can earn action points for completing Instant Combats, raids, killing family raid bosses and for PvP points in Glacernon (Act 4).


So now you’re ready. Rally your family around you and get started!

Have fun!
The NosTale Family
